epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 思南和丈夫前往吉隆玻度假,希望能緩解懷孕帶來的壓力。然而,她意外發現丈夫有個陰險的計畫,要將他們的孩子變成「碌葛」以謀取利潤,使她陷入危險之中。思南幸得酒店鬼魂的幫助,成功逃脫並報警將丈夫拘捕,最終安..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Si Nan and her husband travel to Kuala Lumpur for a vacation to relieve her pregnancy stress. However, she soon uncovers his evil plan to turn their child into a Luk Krok for profit, which puts her in grave danger. With the help of the hotel ghosts, she manages to flee and alert the police to arrest him, finally giving birth to her child.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鬼妻娜娜再次回歸,為一名遭受性侵導致流產的孕婦報仇。除鬼妻娜娜外,沒有人能認出襲擊者的身份。娜娜為報仇變成厲鬼,並要懲罰襲擊者的惡行。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mae Nak the ghost wife returns to take revenge for a pregnant woman who is sexually assaulted and loses her baby. No one can identify the assailant except Mae Nak, who turns into an evil spirit in order to punish the assailant for his evil deeds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位記者調查二十年前紙人回魂案時,聽到三個關於恐怖紙人的故事。故事起源於喬府大小姐喬媛媛枉死後,管家請紙紮匠為小姐做了紙人陪葬。紙人被點眼睛後,大小姐得以借紙人回魂復仇,更接二連三引發連串與紙人有關的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當年輕母親為女兒莫名失蹤而苦惱時,一連串怪異的事件接踵而至。這都可能與二十年前的意外亡魂為復仇歸來有關…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As a young mother grapples with her daughters mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect.  However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 依成和朋友到聚魂靈山探險,傳說山中埋著千年女屍,千年不滅之陰火,進去的人都逃不出來。淩晨兩點半,依成的朋友先後突然消失。在森林搜索期間,依成進入無限輪回的靈異空間,更恐怖的事情卻接踵而來…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 思南和丈夫前往吉隆玻度假,希望能緩解懷孕帶來的壓力。然而,她意外發現丈夫有個陰險的計畫,要將他們的孩子變成「碌葛」以謀取利潤,使她陷入危險之中。思南幸得酒店鬼魂的幫助,成功逃脫並報警將丈夫拘捕,最終安..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Si Nan and her husband travel to Kuala Lumpur for a vacation to relieve her pregnancy stress. However, she soon uncovers his evil plan to turn their child into a Luk Krok for profit, which puts her in grave danger. With the help of the hotel ghosts, she manages to flee and alert the police to arrest him, finally giving birth to her child.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 思南和丈夫前往吉隆玻度假,希望能緩解懷孕帶來的壓力。然而,她意外發現丈夫有個陰險的計畫,要將他們的孩子變成「碌葛」以謀取利潤,使她陷入危險之中。思南幸得酒店鬼魂的幫助,成功逃脫並報警將丈夫拘捕,最終安..

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鬼妻娜娜再次回歸,為一名遭受性侵導致流產的孕婦報仇。除鬼妻娜娜外,沒有人能認出襲擊者的身份。娜娜為報仇變成厲鬼,並要懲罰襲擊者的惡行。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mae Nak the ghost wife returns to take revenge for a pregnant woman who is sexually assaulted and loses her baby. No one can identify the assailant except Mae Nak, who turns into an evil spirit in order to punish the assailant for his evil deeds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位記者調查二十年前紙人回魂案時,聽到三個關於恐怖紙人的故事。故事起源於喬府大小姐喬媛媛枉死後,管家請紙紮匠為小姐做了紙人陪葬。紙人被點眼睛後,大小姐得以借紙人回魂復仇,更接二連三引發連串與紙人有關的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 全球暖化解凍遠古冰層,釋出一股邪惡孢子,為人類帶來毀滅浩劫。逃難中的Meadow躲進一間廢棄小屋,卻發現自己並非孤身一人。她必須與其他倖存者並肩求生,因為感染者正蛻變為饑渴的獵人,對活人展開殘酷獵殺。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Global warming has awakened a malevolent spore from beneath an ancient ice field, unleashing a horrific plague that ravages humanity. Fleeing the chaos, Meadow takes refuge in an abandoned cabin. Together with other strangers, she fights to survive as some succumb to the plague, transforming into ravenous hunters who now stalk the living.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年,富甲一方的康氏慘遭滅門,唯一的目擊證人—家中的幼女—在親眼目睹全家被殺後離奇失蹤。幾十年間,位於青木巷的廢棄康宅充斥著靈異驚悚的氣氛。隨著真相逐漸揭露,這個恐怖的疑團交織著復仇與死亡的動機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter —the sole witness— mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鍾馗收伏狐妖後回到河陽村,卻發現戀人芊芊與鄉親慘遭屠殺。為追查真兇,他下山前往陵都城尋找線索,途中邂逅因妖魔所害而化為半人半妖的琉璃公主。鍾馗揮舞降魔劍斬妖除魔,誓要拯救琉璃公主並守護城池安寧。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After hunting fox demons, Zhong Kui returns to Heyang Village only to discover that his lover and neighbours have been slaughtered. Following the trail to Lingdu City, he encounters Princess Liu Li, who has been cursed into a half-human, half-monster form. Armed with his demon-slaying sword, he battles the demons to save Liu Li and protect the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個寧靜的晚上,一名患精神病的連環殺手擾亂了年輕夫婦的平淡生活。當這對夫婦為生存而戰時,他們隱藏多年的秘密亦隨之揭開,期間更意外地被牽連到黑社會的地下世界中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young couples tranquility is shattered by a psychotic serial killer one quiet evening. Their battle for survival reveals hidden truths, entangling them unwittingly with the criminal underworld.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 失明的游己任在離島的工廠工作。一天,因颶風的破壞,工廠與外界隔絕。此時突然有一隻怪物來襲,任何看到怪物的人都會化成黑影。因游己任看不見怪物,他能成功協助夥伴安全離開,更奮戰反擊,誓要殺死怪物!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory in an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help other coworkers leave safely and fight to kill the monster!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個不斷以自己的標準審判別人的司機,總是用自己的方式默默為他人著想,試圖救贖一個又一個在他眼中的“受害者。當他心儀的女性朋友似被其兒子利用,他不惜擅行私刑,漸漸成為冷血的連環殺手…

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jennifer moves into a new apartment after leaving her abusive husband. As she starts life anew, something keeps biting her when she sleeps, leading her to be sleep deprived, paranoid and paralyzed with fear of the unseen.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 珍妮花離開虐待她的丈夫後搬進了新公寓。當她準備開展新生活時,卻發現睡覺時總被某些東西咬一口,使她變得睡眠不足和疑神疑鬼,更產生了莫名的恐懼。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jennifer moves into a new apartment after leaving her abusive husband. As she starts life anew, something keeps biting her when she sleeps, leading her to be sleep deprived, paranoid and paralyzed with fear of the unseen.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 被譽為“屍語者的法醫秦明常可在屍體身上解剖出重要的線索。在調查一宗謀殺案時,秦明在實習助手和刑警隊長的協助下發現了塵封16年的雪山殺人案,同時亦揭發離奇謀殺案背後隱藏著的秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Renowned as the corpse whisperer, forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect.  However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Jennifer參加了一個探索荷蘭著名風車的旅行團。在途中,旅遊巴發生故障,迫使他們住進一所陰森的小屋,附近更有座可怕的風車。當部分團友突然離奇失蹤時,Jennifer發現他們之間隱藏著一個共同的秘密..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jennifer joins a tour to explore the renowned windmills of the Netherlands. As their tour coach breaks down on the way, they seek refuge in a creepy shed near a sinister windmill with a dark history. When some tour members suddenly disappear, Jennifer discovers a shared secret among them, linking their fates in a chilling revelation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 女模特余虹敏入住了一間公寓式醫院,不久後在深夜離奇墜樓身亡。坊間開始流傳該醫院是「幽靈醫院」。事後,余虹敏的攝影師在深夜頻頻接到詭異電話,撰稿人在一場離奇車禍後神志不清,而她的好友則神秘失蹤…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Model Min is admitted to a hospital, but mysteriously falls to her death at night. Rumour has it that the hospital is haunted. Subsequently, Mins photographer begins receiving eerie phone calls, the writer loses consciousness in a bizarre car accident, and her friend mysteriously disappears…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 電影由三個恐怖短故事組成:一個男人收到死神通報後,設法避過死亡;男人因心愛的妻子去世後傷心欲絕,他的妻子變成鬼魂與他通靈;三兄弟在一次晚餐聚會上為照顧年邁母親的問題而爭吵,最後竟變成一宗可怕的謀殺案。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 書生王懷卿賣畫,為要籌藥費救患重病的妻子,途中意外遇上雀妖的追擊,幸得狐妖小容相救。為躲避雀妖,王懷卿將小容帶回家中,三人隨即陷入一場情感困局,而一段淒美的人妖虐戀亦隨即展開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在朋友去世後,一群年輕人前往倫敦郊外的一座別墅,這裡隱藏著撲朔迷離的謎團。隨著度假期間詭異事件不斷發生,他們必須揭開別墅深藏的黑暗秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Following the death of their friend, a group of young adults travels to a villa on the outskirts of London that contains a deep mystery. As unsettling events escalate during their luxurious stay, they must unravel the villa’s dark secrets.

可是,楊勵沒有想到真正的賣家即“夜巴黎的女主人竟然..

件,檢察院副檢察長神秘死亡。在成立破案小組時,市委領導點

故事發生在風景優美的中國農業大學校園。戴小明(石展飾)是農大的一名學生,其貌不揚。若不是天生開朗幽默的個性,他幾乎不會引起別人的注意。他文理皆優,惟獨對體育科目十分怵頭--他實在不愛運動。
一次,戴小明被死黨彭誠(劉曉燁飾)生拉硬拽去歡迎..

文化宮內,棋盤上,古代戰爭場面瞬間變成一盤象棋殘局,象棋大師陳文山無奈之下棄..

The Five Venom alumnus and Chang Cheh discovery, Lo Meng, teams up with Liu Chia-liang protege Wang Yu, as they inadvertently turn from vagabond kung-fu school operators into anti-Ching, patriotic fighters.

epg.programme_title_en: Whose Baby is in the Classroom?
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 化學教師陳子風在一間保守的女校任教,與青梅竹馬的李海倫共事。陳在醫務所拾得棄嬰,後把棄嬰帶到學校照顧,卻被學生謠傳嬰孩乃陳與李之私生子。陳不但輕鬆面對,還將朝氣帶入校園,大受學生歡迎,李亦漸漸愛上陳。但保守派對陳之作風不滿,侍機剷除陳。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls’ high school, is stuck with a baby that isn’t his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching, an uptight teacher in the same school.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 女俠「金燕子」的兄長被山贼擄走,幸得武功高強的「醉俠」范大悲相助,從作惡多端的寺廟主持手上救出兄長。本片曾代表香港出戰第39屆奧斯卡金像獎最佳外語片的首輪評選。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The brother of the mystery swordswoman Golden Swallow” is kidnapped. She joins forces with a beggar “Drunken Cat” who is skilled in martial arts to free her brother from a Buddhist monastery run by a corrupt abbot. The film was selected as Hong Kong’s entry for the Best Foreign Language Film at the 39th Academy Awards.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述三女意外獲得大筆財產,必須遠赴日本領取,途中遇上三位男人,也想分一杯羹。正當大家各懷鬼胎,彼此攻擊、賄賂甚至出賣對方,企圖獨佔鉅款時,殊不知更驚悚的遭遇正嚴陣以待。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A crippled billionaire mails a letter to each of his long-lost daughters inviting them to go to Japan, in the hope that he will find a worthy heir to inherit his vast fortune. The sisters finally meet abroad the plane to Japan, and one of them is taken with a man who is going to investigate the death of his lawyer uncle in a mysterious hit-and-run.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 正派「鐵旗門」與反派「神鷹堂」,一直對立。一次,「神鷹堂」堂主以向「鐵旗門」陪罪為辭,邀「鐵旗門」門主鐵麟偕弟子往總壇喝酒;鐵認為內中有詐,不宜前往,但大弟子曹風則力言將計就計,若彼等有所行動,就乘機將他們消滅,鐵允之。「神鷹堂」果然十面埋伏,鐵等將敵人逐一殲滅;惟鐵竟在混亂中遇害,卻未知死於誰手…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When super director Chang Cheh found new talent and blood with The Five Venoms actors, most of which were trained in the highly acrobatic Chinese opera and well versed with exotic martial arts weapons, this created a new spark for his use of bizarre weapons in his films. The Flag Of Iron is one of 20 movies that he directed featuring the utterly flabbergasting and physically exhausting action bits created by these five dudes. You have the good guys from the righteous clan versus the bad guys from the villainous clan and its so filled with dont-blink-or-you-will-miss-something gags, you will need to watch it over and over again so you can see the things you missed.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 改編自著名中國神話《封神演義》中的章節,故事講述三千年前哪吒為救父母而犧牲自己的性命,後來因元神被置於蓮花內令他復活,哪吒更獲賜兩件寶物去解救因暴帝而受苦的百姓。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adapted from a chapter of the classic Chinese legend “Investiture of the Gods”, this is the story of Na Cha set 3000 years ago. After Na Cha sacrificed his life to save his parents, he is reincarnated with his spirit embodied in a lotus flower and is armed with two magic weapons to save the people from their despotic emperor.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 方剛的父親為救神風大俠齊如峰而死,齊如峰感念救命之恩,收留方剛入金刀門。方剛卻飽受師兄等人的歧視,於是決定遠走他鄉。齊如峰的獨女與方剛決戰時,竟用刀斬斷其右臂,方剛卻因此練成獨臂刀法,最終更挺身而出救助齊如峰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Accepted to the Golden Sword School after his father sacrificed his life to save his master, Fang Kang is resented by his fellow pupils and decides to leave. His masters daughter challenges him to a fight and cuts off his arm. Fang masters the art of sword fighting with one arm and finds himself returning to the School to save his master again.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 歌星白眉有一豪宅,與空姐朱黛、舞女姚姚同住,三女各有愛情際遇;白眉雖愛錢,卻傾情自稱從外地來的路俊,兩人只好互許後會有期之願;朱黛曾迷戀已婚飛機師,分手後又愛上賽車手;姚姚的最大心願是把清白之軀留給丈夫,她本最愛窮工人李吉,李吉卻因自卑而忍痛分手,姚姚嫁予富家子,卻仍掛念李吉...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong societys differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 劇情描述楊過逃離全真教,誤打誤撞與小龍女相遇。二人在古墓生活,本為融洽;後小龍女為師姐李莫愁所傷,更遭尹志平迷姦。小龍女誤以為失身於楊過,遂提婚議,楊過不知就裡加以婉拒,小龍女悲憤離開古墓。楊過四出訪尋,終與小龍女重逢;惟重提婚事,卻為黃蓉勸阻。小龍女為不讓師徒戀損楊過聲譽,悄然出走...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yang Guo and Xiao Long Nu are deeply in love and live harmoniously in the ancient tomb. Xiao Long Nu proposes marriage one day but Yang Guo declines. Heartbroken, she leaves without a word. Devastated by her absence, Yang Guo searches tirelessly for her. When they finally reunite, he begs her to marry him—only for her to refuse his proposal.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廣西蛇山中有三條巨蛇──蛇王子、黑蛇將及黃蛇將;一夜三蛇化成人形與苗寨男女載歌載舞,蛇王子更因此愛上苗寨女子黑琴。後苗寨旱災,蛇王子答應率蛇作法,引水入寨,但條件是要娶黑琴為妻...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Snake Prince lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with other snakes and they have lived peacefully with humans for a thousand years.  All things change however, when the Snake Prince falls in love with one of the three beauties performing a sensual rain dance in the nearby village one day, and decides to marry her at all costs...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由三個民初故事串聯而成的喜劇小品,許冠文一人分飾多角,其中包括剃頭學徒:有一街坊中風而死,許代師傅守靈,為打發時間與眾人在靈堂玩起「麻雀耍樂」,怎料屍體突然觸電翻生!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barbers apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 路人甲狗雜種走火入魔失去記憶後, 被誤認為幫主。原來幫主名為石中玉和他長成一樣, 是雪山派的劣徒後逃跑了。後來石中玉終於出現了......
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this surprisingly light-hearted Venoms martial arts adventure, a lone wanderer is repeatedly mistaken for someone else and drawn into a number of violent battles.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 路人甲狗雜種走火入魔失去記憶後, 被誤認為幫主。原來幫主名為石中玉和他長成一樣, 是雪山派的劣徒後逃跑了。後來石中玉終於出現了......
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this surprisingly light-hearted Venoms martial arts adventure, a lone wanderer is repeatedly mistaken for someone else and drawn into a number of violent battles.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片為徐蝦導演。 董驃, 錢小豪及蔣金飾扒手, 惟董失手被捕; 董出獄後裝南洋闊客, 隨錢及蔣返家, 因為想扮相古怪, 惹途人圍觀, 三人乘機施妙手, 更向盤問的保安隊長羅莽自詡身份特殊, 使羅躬身謝罪...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bill’s nieces!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 黃飛鴻與天壽武館之王隱林年少氣盛,得罪陸正甫武館少主及其騁用的高手單雄,從而掀起武館間的正面衝突。本片是劉家良導演最得意的作品,更是1981年十大賣座電影之一。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The young Wong Fei Hung and his friend Wang Yin Lin offend the young master of another rival school and the expert they hire, causing both martial arts schools to fight against each other. This is Director Liu Chia Liang’s masterpiece and one of the top ten highest grossing movies in 1981.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 抗日戰爭期間,少年孤女唐琪愛上青年張醒亞。家庭的壓力與戰爭的動盪令這對有情人飽受煎熬。直至唐琪不幸被強姦,不容於家庭, 而唯有走上夜總會歌女的不歸路...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set during the Japanese occupation in World War II, a young orphan Tang Qi falls in a love with a young man Chang. However, their love is filled with challenges, from family pressure to the turmoil of war.  When Tang Qi was raped, she is expelled from home to become a nightclub singer and embarks on a journey of no return…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 戴天仇自幼習武,矢志為父報仇。彼時其殺父仇人,到處為非作歹。戴上路途中遇上女扮男裝的吳小燕,並突遭多名幫會中人毒打,吳遂求父允其把戴帶返家中養傷。戴竟因此得以混入仇人地盤,希望可乘機報仇...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dai Tian Chou practices martial arts since young so he can avenge his father’s death.  He meets Wu Xiao Yan who is disguised as a man one day and is suddenly beaten by a group of gangsters. Wu begs her father to allow her to take Dai back home to recover. Little does Dai know this is his chance to take revenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 美麗但無知的李天珍被外星人捉上飛碟,事後無人相信她曾與外星人接觸。於是,當她打算一死以示清白之際,卻遇上同有輕生念頭的失敗私家偵探伊電。二人互吐心聲後改變主意,卻遭遇一連串奇遇,而二人的愛情故事也因此開始。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A beautiful but ignorant woman is abducted by aliens but nobody believes her close encounter. While planning a suicide to prove herself, she meets a failed detective who is also planning his suicide. They change their minds about dying after finding each other and start to encounter bizarre adventures, before falling in love with each other.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 博士的助手偷去藏有新研發原子爐秘密的微型底片,賣給犯罪集團。不料,途中卻意外地落入一名夜總會舞女和一名扒手的手中。犯罪集團為取回底片,與二人展開連場追逐。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A professor’s assistant stole a micro-film storing the secret of a newly invented nuclear reactor and sells it to a crime syndicate. However, the micro-film accidentally falls into the hands of a nightclub dancer and a thief in the process, leading to them being relentlessly pursued by the crime syndicate to retrieve the micro-film.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大偉和小春是同胞兄弟,一個放浪,一個含蓄。小春在舞會邂逅女子珠迪,情心一片。大偉發現珠迪有個年老丈夫,得知此秘密,大偉以此威脅,迫珠迪和他幽會,自始珠迪周旋三個男人之間... 導演以女性角度大膽描寫男女情關,手法細膩,而結局亦出人意表。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Aptly described by its original title of Money, Sex And Love, this is a gripping drama about Judy, a woman with a rich husband as well as two lovers who happen to be brothers. Jenny Hu is Judy, and her knockout beauty makes this summer sizzle...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 乾隆原來並非皇位繼承人,而在出生時被調包,但他一直被蒙在鼓裡,直至地下組織紅花會的人相告。而紅花會總舵主陳家洛是其同胞兄弟。兩弟兄因身世和利益必需身不由己地彼此對抗…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Emperor Qianlong is not the legitimate successor to the throne at birth, but he only learns the truth when two senior members of a subversive anti-government secret organisation contact him years later. As it happens,  the chef of this organisation is Qianlong’s younger brother and they must now confront each other in opposing roles…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 李子良喪妻後,與兩個兒子相依為命。妻子的巨額醫藥費令子良經濟十分拮据,受同事教唆往馬場孤注一擲,迫得向高利貸借款,從此子良債臺高築,疲於奔命,沒有時間與兒子溝通,父子疏離。與此同時高利貸不斷登門恐嚇,騷擾兒子,最終弄至悲劇發生…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 改編自俠義小說《七俠五義》,人物繁多,情節多變,難得張徹處理得有條不紊,角色性格分明。故事講述襄陽王在王府中,建造的沖霄樓機關密佈,又廣招花蝴蝶花沖、神手大聖鄧車和小諸葛沈仲元等江湖俠士加盟,伺機造反。包公得悉襄陽王叛跡,乃命門生顏春敏前往調查。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An evil prince has hidden the stolen imperial treasures in a house filled with booby-trapped blades. Amid plasma-spurting attacks, heroes and rogues try to uncover the deadly secrets of the house...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片由三個內容不同的故事構成。青年喜歡偷窺異性,結果其姐懇求雇主交際花實行肉身布施,驚醒青年迷夢。好色總經理常設計欲打美貌秘書的主意,偷香不到,反被懲戒。好丈夫喪失性能力,不願妻子痛苦,故作暴躁舉動,讓其妻帶著女兒離去,十年後,一家才得以諒解。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The movie offers three stories of love and obsession. In the first tale, a young student with a voyeuristic habit spies on two of his female roommates. The second story follows an office manager who develops an infatuation for his secretary. The last story is a complex family drama about a debilitated father who forces his family to leave him.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南劍丁夢豪是「天下第一劍」,卻敗於路過的怪和尚。丁履行諾言,跟他苦修三年石工。丁修煉期滿返回家鄉後,仍有不少武林人士冒名找他決戰,唯丁欲隱居民間,所以堅拒一切挑戰。無奈後來卻要被逼與北劍再來一場生死決鬥,究竟最後會是鹿死誰手?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Southern Swordsman Ting is named “The Fastest Sword” but is defeated by a street monk and has to fulfil his promise of working on stone craving with the monk for three years. Ting returns home to lead a peaceful life after that and declines all fight challenges. Even so, he is forced to fight the Northern Swordsman. Who will win finally?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 陳詠薇的父母準備離異,於是把她送到章家暫住。章家長子凌霄、次子凌風、三女凌雲和年輕畫家余亞南都對詠薇很好,使她在章家農場度過了難忘的暑假。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Chang’s. On the Chang’s farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是一個耳熟能詳之中國民間神話故事,講述書生劉彥昌巧遇落入凡間的聖母三娘,二人一見鍾情,結下一段仙凡姻緣。但因與二郎神結怨,屢遭迫害,二郎神更將聖母壓在華山底下。彥昌與聖母之子沉香長大後,聞悉生母被壓華山,悲憤欲絕,藉神斧之助挫敗二郎神,劈山救母。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Linda Lin Dai plays both mother and son in this lavish fable about a goddess who falls in love with a mortal scholar (Cheng Pei-pei in her debut role). Over two years in production, it was released on the first anniversary of Lindas tragic suicide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是一個耳熟能詳之中國民間神話故事,講述書生劉彥昌巧遇落入凡間的聖母三娘,二人一見鍾情,結下一段仙凡姻緣。但因與二郎神結怨,屢遭迫害,二郎神更將聖母壓在華山底下。彥昌與聖母之子沉香長大後,聞悉生母被壓華山,悲憤欲絕,藉神斧之助挫敗二郎神,劈山救母。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Linda Lin Dai plays both mother and son in this lavish fable about a goddess who falls in love with a mortal scholar (Cheng Pei-pei in her debut role). Over two years in production, it was released on the first anniversary of Lindas tragic suicide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述二次大戰日軍侵佔上海,中國海軍力量薄弱,難以跟日艦抗衡;為保存戰力,在長江布下水雷,將一艘魚雷快艇偽裝成漁船,乘夜突襲...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Chinese Navy is attempting to defend its coastline from a Japanese attack, they send their commando unit led by Cui Hsia into the mainland to enlist help to thwart the Japanese before they attack. The commandos enlist the help of Song San and Shiao Liu to kill the Japanese officers led by Shan Mao and destroy their attacking ships.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 的士司機阿發與少女阿霞相愛已久,但發有神經錯亂,霞為除心理負擔,忍痛分手; 發大鬧霞家並斷指示真心,令霞感動而復合。然發卻不務正業,令霞甚為反感;一次爭執間,發狂性大發,霞流產,再次離開發...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述偵緝警長趙敬才因一次行動,連累下屬被劫匪擊斃,而被上司指責處事魯莽,改派督察邱正明接辦案件。敬才與正明辦案作風迥異,衝突日多。職業殺手利子健受雇來港狙殺殷商徐文,豈料行動時卻誤中副車,僅殺死徐文之助手;當徐文查得殺手為子健後,急欲除之。警方接獲線報,即派正明與敬才率隊出發,阻止黑幫火拼……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two very different cops are out to capture a local drug boss. In this sizzling crime thriller, the two cops go about doing their jobs differently - one does everything to the letter of the law and the other just doing whatever it takes to solve crime.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 餘腩沉溺賭海,由於欠債累累無力償還,遂答應債主以其妻肉償債項。事件被其妻識破,並決意離餘而去。餘動輕生念頭,可最終自殺未遂。餘遇上一名富家老伯,老伯答應給餘巨額現金,只要餘答應幫他娶得美人歸...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 丁典獲得秘典「神照經」及可以成為天下第一巨富的「連城訣」,且與知府淩退思的女兒霜華相戀,淩為奪秘典,將丁打下牢獄。狄雲于死囚獄中認識丁,被傳授「神照功」。淩狠心對女兒下毒手,丁憤然與狄越獄,結果被毒死,而「連城訣」竟然在…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A corrupt magistrate, obsessed with finding a hidden treasure, jails and tortures his daughters lover and buries his daughter alive! Ironically, it is in her coffin that the secret to the hidden treasure is found, setting off a frenzy of destruction.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述張愛珠無意得知自己是孤兒,故往找生母。生母茱莉與流氓劉老四同居,老四心起歪念,竟欲非禮愛珠,茱莉救了女兒,卻被老四誤殺。愛珠逃回養父母家,始深深體會到養父母對她的愛。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Li Ching, star of Sweet is Revenge, plays one of three daughters, whose life is turned upside down when she discovers she is adopted. But things get even worse when she goes in search of her real mother. Finally, after what is almost a double tragedy, she realizes what so many knew all along: Theres no place like home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 桂武與甘聯珠夫婦二人是江湖上著名的「鴛鴦劍俠」。一天,二人不慎墮入紅蓮寺的綁架陰謀。當甘聯珠不慎被擒時,桂武成功逃脫並找甘家協助,卻不曉得自己會使甘氏陷入綁架者的伏擊之中。最後桂武能否成功救出甘聯珠?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gui Wu and his wife Gan Lian Zhu are the famous “Twin Swords” in the martial arts world. One day, they stumble upon a kidnapping plot at the Red Lotus Temple and Lian Zhu is held captive. Wu successfully escapes to find the Gan family for help, not knowing that he is sending them into an ambush by the kidnappers. Can he finally save Lian Zhu?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事源自膾炙人口的《啼笑因緣》,內容描述民國初年,富家子范嘉恕戀上歌女岑逢仙,同時又唯賣藝少女官繡珠及貌似岑的財政廳長女兒賀莉霞所迷戀。張大帥垂涎岑,更姦污了她。嘉恕後得繡珠相助,才從大帥手中救回愛人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fan Jia Shu is a kind-hearted student who is smitten with Shen, a heart-rending love song singer. However, he is not the only one who has eyes for Shen. The General’s henchmen are also determined to present the songstress to their superior as a gift. Fan receives help from an unexpected person just in time to save the woman he loves.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 楚留香與八王爺設下計謀,佯裝行刺失敗,趁機潛入「幽靈山莊」作臥底,意圖將這座罪惡巢穴一舉殲滅。山莊內聚集了江湖上惡貫滿盈的亡命之徒,且傳言時有鬼魅出沒。楚留香在查探過程中,逐漸陷入一連串懸疑詭祕的事件之中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chu Liuxiang and the Eighth Prince stage a fake assassination attempt, allowing Chu to infiltrate Ghostly Manor as an undercover agent and eradicate this den of evil. The manor harbours notorious martial arts criminals and is rumoured to be haunted. Soon, during his investigation, Chu becomes entangled in a series of mysterious and eerie events.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莊家農場獨子莊士德海外歸來,接手由胡麟管理的產業。胡一直與德之表妹曼玲勾結,圖取莊家產業,並欲利用曼玲美色迷惑德!怎知在阿芬飼養的小蛇「西西」幫助下,反令德與芬結成夫婦。後來胡買來一條專咬人的野老鼠,欲將德之初生嬰兒咬死,「西西」為救嬰兒,與野鼠作殊死搏鬥...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Incredibly, the title serpent is not a harbinger of horror, but actually the films hero. This virtuous viper sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a duplicitous woman. This one-of-a-kind thriller will be applauded by reptile fans everywhere.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明惠帝被篡位後,太子被藏匿在武林義士的黑龍會中,卻被武林敗類所襲擊,迫使入世未深的劍客及俠女帶著太子逃亡。他們一路上危機重重,幸得其他義士拔刀相助……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After the Ming Emperor is overthrown and his infant son was put in the care of the Black Dragon Society, a traitorous martial arts clan attacks the society, forcing an inexperienced pair of swordsman and swordswoman to flee with the infant. Their journey to deliver the infant to safety is filled with dangers that would require help from other allies…

epg.programme_title_en: Intimate Confessions of a Chinese Courtesan
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 弱質少女金娥,被賣入妓院強迫接客,受盡欺凌,悲憤之餘,假意奉承,化名愛奴,跟鴇母春姨學習奇特武功,又投其所好與春發展一段同性戀,目的就是報仇,後來愛奴將曾競投她初夜的嫖客逐一殺死……。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young Ai Nu is abducted and sold to the popular Four Seasons brothel run by the powerful and ruthless Madam Chun Yi. Ai Nu gets locked up in a dungeon due to her fiery attitude. Soon, a murder occurs within the brothel and a policeman must race against time to prevent a vicious revenge plot from reaching its blood-spattered conclusion.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 呂紫英陪同父呂天奇到台灣發展,兩姐白虹、青萍留港繼續歌舞生涯。白虹認識江慶良後投契相戀,江向老闆引薦白虹在歌劇中當主角,老父回來見三位女兒成就,開心不已。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十八年前,胡斐之父胡一刀,與苗人鳳交換刀劍比武,被己刀傷,繼而身亡,原來胡之刀早被田歸農塗上毒藥;苗妻南蘭被田勾引,竟拋夫棄女,后田更以毒粉弄瞎苗雙眼;斐見苗受此遭遇,決定代其向藥王求救,亦因此碰上一生中最愛的藥王傳人程靈素……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young man, Chin, believes he is an orphan, until he meets three men and learns from them that his father was a great swordsman who was killed when he was trying to dispel rumors of a wrongdoing and return a lost sword to its rightful owner. Chin seeks out the men’s help to take vengeance on the wrongful death of his father.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十八年前,胡斐之父胡一刀,與苗人鳳交換刀劍比武,被己刀傷,繼而身亡,原來胡之刀早被田歸農塗上毒藥;苗妻南蘭被田勾引,竟拋夫棄女,后田更以毒粉弄瞎苗雙眼;斐見苗受此遭遇,決定代其向藥王求救,亦因此碰上一生中最愛的藥王傳人程靈素……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young man, Chin, believes he is an orphan, until he meets three men and learns from them that his father was a great swordsman who was killed when he was trying to dispel rumors of a wrongdoing and return a lost sword to its rightful owner. Chin seeks out the men’s help to take vengeance on the wrongful death of his father.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 朱國棟和李明珠本打算結婚,無奈雙方父母為多年死對頭,所以堅決反對婚事。於是二人不惜假裝自殺。有見及此雙方家長最終冰釋前嫌,答應二人成婚。此時,唱片公司宣佈會為出棟的歌曲版,最終可謂雙喜臨門。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dong’s songs, leading to double bliss for the couple.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武功秘笈《童子功》原掌握在正義武林人士的手中,江湖異人龍無天盜去前三招,龍為實現稱霸江湖的野心,決心要將那本武功秘笈的所有招式弄到手。他率領一群爪牙四處掠索,橫行江湖。浪俠及甘素凡二位青年,抱著為師復仇、為民除害的決心,各自苦練武功,分別跟蹤龍無天,歷經數劫,師兄妹兩人終於重逢相認,並肩作戰.....
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lung seeks five volumes of a renowned Kung Fu manual to gain invincibility. When he believes a martial arts school master possesses the volumes, he kills him and his daughter but leaves behind a young brother and sister. Years later, Lung loses two volumes and starts another bloody hunt but each attempt is interrupted by two mysterious warriors...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以「趕屍」為業的陳師父與徒弟受託押運九具殭屍,啟程上路。未料途中兩具竟逃脫。其中一具實際上並非殭屍,而是為躲避敵人追殺而假扮的江湖豪客。更令人意外的是,此人與陳師父同樣身懷絕技,二人皆為深不可測的武林高手!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述,江湖出現一貧僧打扮名喚小毒龍之殺手,嫉惡如仇,專殺江湖敗類。她乃大悲寺瘋僧之門徒,亦即「毒龍劍」的傳人李寶珠;她獨來獨往神出鬼沒,歹徒聞風喪膽。她身背父仇,待中秋與仇人在十字坡一決生死。陳仕倫為李之表哥,乃鐵扇子之高徒,率十字坡鄉民嚴陣以待,助李抗敵…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Liu seeks out Li to avenge his brother’s death and loses an arm in the fight, vowing revenge ten years later. Li dies after asking his sister to send his daughter Bao Zhu to learn the Dragon Sword skill to avenge his death. Bao Zhu grows up to become a skilled swordswoman and meets Liu for the planned duel with her cousin Chen. Can she defeat Liu?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述,陳太太有女潔玉及美玉,潔玉已工作,美玉仍求學。適逢陳家有空房出租,少奇來租,一談即合;潔玉三個姊姊,皆與租客結婚,所以潔玉表姊趙靜蘭之母決仿效陳家租房選婿。未幾,一醫科學生欣農來租房,趙母見他是理想快婿,忙出租。原來少奇與欣農是同學,少奇老成寡言,被潔玉、美玉視為怪人,欣農則只顧談戀愛…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Some of Shaw Brothers biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述,元初元人派大將軍莽依圖打擊反元分子;反元聯盟潛龍幫正處外憂內患,伏幫主、石副幫主雙雙去世,繼任人伏中原又為石夫人持信證明為元人,中原遂私下追尋身世真相。期間中原往將軍府盜取結盟名冊時,幾乎遇險,幸為女飛贼林雪兒所救…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is a story about an army out to destroy the Hsien Lung gang of anti-Yuan revolutionaries. Their leader Ru Yi Tu is up against Fu Zhong Yuan, the identified successor of the Hsien Lung gang who must also prove his own legitimacy. The plot thickens with murder, sibling rivalry and shocking discoveries that could change the course of history.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 王金龍與名妓蘇三相愛,無奈無錢被趕出富春院。蘇被老鴇賣予富戶沈燕林為妾,卻被沈妻誣告毒殺親夫,判以死罪。已考取功名的王,決意開堂覆審救蘇...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: TIn this Huangmei Opera romance, Wang is the son of a respected government official whereas Sue San is a famous prostitute. Although they love each other and seem to be perfectly matched, the two are worlds apart when it comes to social ranking, which will prove hard to overcome...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 申九蚣與黃飛鴻結怨後,設計陷害他及其弟子謀殺。幸得商人周立德相助,黃飛鴻才倖免於難,但他卻要在舞獅會時搶得丁財炮以回報周立德。面對各路武林高手,黃飛鴻最終能否完成任務?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As Shen and Wong Fei Hung’s relationship turns sour, Shen frames Wong and his disciple for murder. They are saved by a businessman Zhou, but Wong must win the Lion Dance Trophy to return Zhou’s favour. Can Wong Fei Hung defeat all skilled martial artists and complete his mission?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 影后李菁的代表作,蕭湘反串文必正,傾慕官府小姐霍定金,賣身混入霍家,二人私定終身,必正被陷害入獄,定金設法營救...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Huangmei Opera tradition, this movie tells the love story of Wen, who sells himself as a slave to a rich family, and Huo, the family’s young daughter. The lovers are kept apart by Huo’s stepmother and Huo escapes by dressing up as a man. Wen is framed and put into jail so Huo has to go back and rescue her lover!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 宋太祖趙匡胤之弟光義恃建國有功,囂張跋扈,逼殺南唐後主李煜,李之舊部李浪矢誓報仇。太傅陳搏因欲修煉成仙,必先得皇帝封誥,故與光義妥協,助其奪取帝位,事成後由光義祭天封為華山神仙。陳搏帶光義夜闖禁宮,弒兄自立,並殺死李浪等心腹大患...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The last ruler of Tang, Li Yao is deposed by Chao Kuang-jun, the founder of the Sung Dynasty. Unfortunately his actions unleash a new plague - his brother Kuang-yi - on the courts and his people. The marauding Kuang-yi rapes and plunders. As more people get involved, it turns into a bloody battlefield of betrayal. It is up to upright officials like Li Lang to put an end to it. But can one man take on the imperial army?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走私黃金的犯罪組織首領喬治伊頓潛逃香港,亞洲秘密警察日本支部探員楊明軒遠赴香港緝凶,期間結識香港密探賴雨田,更週旋於美女杏子、春子及楊明華之間。明軒收到情報,喬治欲與澳門賭場負責人卡洛斯將黃金送往日本;明軒與賴雨田趕上船去阻止,與喬治展開惡鬥...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Asiapol agent Yang Ming Xuan trails a shipment of contraband gold being delivered to gang leader, George Eaton. He enlists the help of a Chinese woman who is trying to avenge her sister and narrowly escapes several deadly traps as he closes in on Eatons location. This spy film is loosely inspired by the James Bond movies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一次驅鬼時,青年術士魯興與友人因功力太差被女鬼戲弄險告喪命,幸得連大師施法幫助,才將女鬼驅逐。於是二人馬上拜他為師。友人意外地被日本忍者所殺,魯興決定要學習絕世茅術,與大師一起對付殘暴的忍者,因而引發終極亂鬥!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young Taoist priest Lu and his friend are nearly killed by a female ghost during an exorcism. Luckily, Master Lian saves their lives, so they beseech him to teach them his skills. When his friend is killed by ruthless ninjas, Lu decides to learn the ultimate witchcraft and teams up with his master to defeat them.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 任職推銷員的余小寶失戀後,遇上剛剛跟男友分手的富家女金金。二人同病相憐,很快便墜入愛河並閃電結婚,開展甜蜜的生活。可惜,此時金金卻發現自己懷上了前男友的骨肉...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After breaking up with his girlfriend, salesman Bao meets a rich girl, Jin Jin, who just broke up with her boyfriend. Two equally heartbroken strangers fall in love instantly and get married on impulse. The couple lives happily together until Jin Jin finds herself pregnant with her ex-boyfriend’s baby...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述千金小姐劉月英與丫鬟春蘭同遊花田盛會,邂逅橋邊畫畫的落拓書生卞濟。春蘭眼見小姐芳心暗許,於是穿針引線,欲促成良緣,卻因老家僕錯認小霸王周通為卞濟,使小姐與卞濟情路波折重重。在經過一連串誤會與錯配後,結局乃皆大歡喜。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fête. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servant’s confusion, threatening the couple’s union. After a series of complications, misunderstandings and mismatches, Chun Lan finally saves the day.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述千金小姐劉月英與丫鬟春蘭同遊花田盛會,邂逅橋邊畫畫的落拓書生卞濟。春蘭眼見小姐芳心暗許,於是穿針引線,欲促成良緣,卻因老家僕錯認小霸王周通為卞濟,使小姐與卞濟情路波折重重。在經過一連串誤會與錯配後,結局乃皆大歡喜。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fête. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servant’s confusion, threatening the couple’s union. After a series of complications, misunderstandings and mismatches, Chun Lan finally saves the day.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 年輕女劍客服下奶奶研製的隱身藥後,變成白天隱形晚上現身的怪人。她無意中搗亂了黑道首領女兒的婚事,惹來連番追殺。女劍客最後如何脫險?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young swordswoman becomes invisible during the day and a monster at night after taking her grandma’s pill. She ruined the wedding of a bandit chief’s daughter using her powers and is hunted down by them for revenge. Will she escape the hunt?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本歌舞片由聲色藝各有千秋的何莉莉、鄭佩佩及秦萍合演三姊妹,再配以三大小生淩雲、陳厚及嶽華大鬥演技。由日本名演導井上梅次執導
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This joyous, raucous,  colorful tunefest showcases the little seen dancing talents of celebrated kung-fu swordswoman Cheng Pei-Pei, as one of 3 girls dancing their way to the top.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述清帝雍正為了鞏固統治地位,組織了一暗殺集團「血滴子」,為他殺害異見分子。時有一清廷侍衛統領韓天德者,因不值雍正所為而遭殺害,幸其妻容秋燕適不在家,幸免於難,容悲憤莫名,獨闖「血滴子」統領金罡風家,為夫報仇,終行刺失敗而回。後得棄暗投明之前「血滴子」成員馬騰及其師弟王俊相助,合三人之力終將金罡風殺死,替夫報仇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Flying Guillotine assassins are secretly working for the Emperor and its leader Jin is sent to kill Hon, who knows this secret. Hon’s pregnant wife Rong seeks to kill Jin but retreats to protect her unborn child. When she is hunted down herself, Rong hooks up with a former Flying Guillotine member and her martial arts senior to fight back...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明朝時代,書生田玉川因替漁夫伸張正義,誤殺總督之子,被迫逃亡。走投無路時,他逃至江畔,幸得漁夫之女相救。二人在險境中情愫暗生,玉川遂以傳家至寶「蝴蝶盃」為信物,締結終身之約。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Ming Dynasty, scholar Tian Yu Chuan defends a fisherman’s honour but accidentally kills the governor’s son, driving him into exile. Pursued to the river’s edge, he is rescued by the fisherman’s daughter. Amid danger, love blossoms between them, and Tian seals their bond with his family heirloom, the Butterfly Chalice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 水兒原是大太子之私生女,流落青樓 ,二太子欲利用水兒揭大太子醜行以謀皇位。大太子不惜派殺手暗殺水兒,而二太子則命燕十三、練飛霞等護送水兒回宮。兩批人沿途激戰,水兒得武士相救避禍隱居荒村,然二人性格迥異經常引起衝突。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Journey Of The Doomed stars Tung Wei as a knight that finds himself protecting the life of a beautiful young lady, the lost Emperors daughter and stalked by a bunch of assassins headed by kung fu actress extraordinaire Hui Ying-Hung.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 延續經典喜劇《72家房客》的成功,本片講述一羣住在香港唐樓的租客被發展商強行迫遷的故事。有些租客願意接受金錢賠償,但有些卻堅決反對。收購計劃最終又會否破壞鄰里間的和諧?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Continuing the success of the classic comedy “House of 72 tenants”, this sequel tells the stories of tenants living in an old building in Hong Kong who are forced to evict by the developers. Some tenants prefer to take the compensation while some resist the move. Will the acquisitions plan destroy the harmony of the neighborhood?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 白衣大俠和黑色醉俠同時愛上女俠金燕子。三人卻聯手對付江湖中的惡勢力。在一場生死對決展開前,金燕子還是遲遲未能作出自己感情的抉擇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A heroine finds herself in a love triangle with a swordsman and a warrior. They team up to conquer the evil forces of the martial arts world but she is unable to choose between both men even as they face a deadly duel.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 魯俊谷、張權、於洋三人乃沙煲兄弟,三人合力獲得寶物「雙面神」,不料卻給胡起尾注,將三人毒殺,獨吞「雙面神」。劉永、梁家仁及梁韻蕊是他們的後人,在不打不相識之下重逢,為了完成亡父的遺志,三人齊心向胡偷回寶物。韻蕊早已混入胡家中,色誘胡之子,作為內應查出「雙面神」之收藏地點。永與家仁則扮鬼扮馬,偷天換日,最後偷得雙面神!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Three buddies find a rare artifact known as the Double-Faced God but are poisoned by Lady Wu who steals the treasure from them. Before they die, they get their wives to promise to train their children to take back what is rightfully theirs. These kids grow up to exact a vengeance that turns out to be more hilarious than horrific in this comedy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雷公為救弟子,不惜將他掌管的雲南義和團分舵解散,並隱居鄉間。義和團委派數名殺手追殺叛徒雷公,但反被雷公消滅。雷公的弟弟雷勇被派往先找出哥哥的下落,然後再將他殺死。最後,兄弟二人反目,決戰定生死。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lei Kung, the leader of the Boxer Clan in Yunnan, dissolves the clan to save his disciples before going into self-exile. The Clan sends various assassins to kill him but failed. They then assigned Kung’s brother Yong to find and kill Kung, leading to a battle between the two brothers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有才華的女藝員蘭蘭與梅梅新加入「馬氏歌舞團」,蘭蘭與團主馬英不和。馬英在報紙匿名徵求女友,蘭蘭與他以匿名用書信往來,互生情愫。相約見面時,兩人膽怯退縮。歌舞團獲邀到日本表演,由馬英帶領,蘭蘭擔任女主角,二人的關係可否趁機會發展?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Acknowledged as one of the greatest Hong Kong musicals, this lavish movie starring Linda Lin, who won Best Actress for her performance, infuses its wispy plot with style and wit, and the results are pure pleasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 受到《醉拳》啟發,這部功夫喜劇描述一名傻頭傻腦的功夫小子自創了一套蟋蟀拳,其後更逐一打敗曾欺凌他的武林人士。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Inspired by “Drunken Master”, this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist creating a cricket-style fighting arts to fight and defeat the different martial artists who have beaten him before.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 良才見秋容貌美,心懷不軌,竟將其迷姦。秋容醒來後為良才甜言蜜意所惑,相信他稟明父母後會娶她為妻。誰知數月後,良才音訊全無,秋容更發現自已懷有身孕,於是馬上去找良才。可惜那時秋容才發現良才已另娶名門閨秀為妻,更打算將秋容滅口…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parent’s consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述,每逢恐怖歌聲出現,必有閻家的人被署名「玉羅剎」者所殺。由於「玉羅剎」神出鬼沒,鬧得滿城風雨。冷秋寒于酒館遇見徐英豪,交談下,知彼也為尋仇而來;冷直告自己實為「玉羅剎」,殺閻家為替全家報仇,徐勸其勿濫殺無辜,冷不聽...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A fearsome swordswoman known as The Jade Raksha appears in the martial arts world and begins killing people whose surname is Yan. A swordsman figures out who she is and asks her why. Apparently a Yan killed her family 18 years ago and she only has vengeance on her mind…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三十五歲的男教師林明娶了十七歲的女學生珍珍。兩人在同一學校上課,隱藏夫妻秘密。珍發覺林明常被女生包圍,而林又發現珍常被男老師追求,期間笑料百出。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to expose their marriage any minute!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 路人甲狗雜種走火入魔失去記憶後, 被誤認為幫主。原來幫主名為石中玉和他長成一樣, 是雪山派的劣徒後逃跑了。後來石中玉終於出現了......
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this surprisingly light-hearted Venoms martial arts adventure, a lone wanderer is repeatedly mistaken for someone else and drawn into a number of violent battles.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 趙春方曾於決鬥敗於龍帥之手下。七年後,龍帥為在賞燈大會上奪魁,往尋趙春方代為製造別緻燈籠。趙春方藉此暗中佈下復仇大計。龍帥之妻無固失蹤後,他驚聞有關人皮燈籠的傳說,並開始懷疑趙春方與失蹤事件有關......
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Long’s wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of human lanterns, Long suspects Zhao may be involved in the incident…

epg.programme_title_en: Holy Flame of the Martial World
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 尹天仇的父母因一對武林聖火令﻿遭人暗算身亡,他和妹妹分別被忠奸兩派收養撫育,兄妹各持一半聖火令,習得絕世武功。起初兩人勢同水火,卻在揭開身世秘密後攜手合作,共同為父母報仇雪恨。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yin Tian Chou’s parents were killed over a pair of flame-shaped blades. He and his sister were rescued, raised, and trained separately by a hero and a villain, each inheriting one of the blades. Sworn enemies at first, they eventually uncover their true identities and join forces to avenge their parents deaths.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 丁芝華綺年玉貌,衣著華麗,將偷回來的珠寶從香港偷運去星加坡。因鑽石不准進口,芝華情急智生,將戒指盒放進陌生男子張志賢衣袋,順利通過,但當出機場時卻不見志賢的蹤跡。芝華找遍星加坡每一角落,都找不到志賢。一日,芝華到泳場,竟巧遇志賢,她便用盡一切方法去接近志賢欲取回戒指…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hua, a pretty fraud, steals a brilliant diamond ring from a shop in Hong Kong and escapes to Singapore. To smuggle the ring pass customs, Hua slips it into the pocket of a stranger, Yen, but then lost track of him. Hua finally spots Yen after searching for days and does everything to get close to him in order to take the ring back.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片為導演岳楓於1966年執導之民初動作片,劇情主要描述,二妞收到父親遇害前寫下的仇人名單,遂連同兄長建明展開一幕奇情追凶…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This wuxia murder mystery film talks about a young girl whose father was ruthlessly murdered during Chinas early republican era. She has a list of villains who have been plotting against her father and together with her elder brother, the young girl sets out on a journey to hunt down the secret serial killer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 話說醫務署發覺聖慕倫醫院的醫療水準及設備大有問題,原來該院院長體弱多病,院務交陳醫生主理;但陳個性主觀,行事不依規章,連手下一班見習醫生亦各具「特性」,時鬧笑話,弄至院務混亂。院長決定聘用資深護士長進行改革...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: At St. Morant Hospital, a harried but lovely administrator must deal with lusty interns, student nurses, a delirious surgeon, a dissection fiend, a criticizing Commissioner and gross negligence at regular intervals! This comedy is based on the hugely successful British Carry On! film series.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 年輕的黃飛鴻誓要證明自己有能力,可以成為父親的習武師傅陸阿采的徒弟。雖然他在一次比武中落敗,但黃飛鴻對武學的熱誠終於感動了陸阿采,並得償所願拜他為師。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young Wong Fei Hung must prove himself worthy to be taught by Master Lu, who was also his father’s martial arts teacher. Although he is defeated in a competition, Wong Fei Hung’s passion in Kung Fu finally moves Lu and allows him to become Lu’s disciple.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 時裝設計師史馬哥向葉德梅徵求她對自己作品的意見,梅卻隨意提出批評,這讓馬哥感到非常不滿。一天,梅準備出席一場盛大的宴會,於是找馬哥為她設計禮服,不料他為報復故意設計了一件小丑裝,讓梅顏面盡失。最終,史馬哥卻很內疚並向梅道歉,兩人冰釋前嫌,並墜入愛河。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fashion designer Shi asks his friend Mui to comment on his new design but is angered by her criticism. When Mui asks him to design a gown for her to attend a gala event, Shi takes revenge by making a clown costume instead. Seeing Mui’s embarrassment, Shi feels guilty and apologizes to her, before they fall in love…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一代宗師黃飛鴻在廣東教授功夫,卻被一名惡毒土匪陷害黃飛鴻的弟子,更以搶劫及謀殺等罪行誣陷他。因此,黃飛鴻誓要與土匪對抗力證自己的清白,並為弟子報仇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The famous kung fu master Wong Fei Hung teaches martial arts in Guangdong. A vicious gangster plots to harm Wong’s disciples and frames him for robbery and murder. Wong has to fight against the culprit to prove his own innocence and take revenge for his disciples.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 許珮青和夏夢軒在宴會相識,因彼此同樣經歷不幸的婚姻,兩人更一見留情。夏夢軒在一次海灘漫步,拾起紫貝殼給珮青留念。許珮青丈夫發現二人關係後,故意傷害她,使她病體支離,同時又勒索夏夢軒。這段愛情故事最後將如何收場?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hui and Ha are stuck in their unhappy marriages and are attracted to each other when they meet at a party. In one of their beach strolls, Ha picks up a purple shell and gives it to Hui as a memento. When Hui’s husband finds out about them, he hurts Hui and causes her to become seriously ill, while also blackmails Ha. How will this love story end?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武功高強的遊俠兒遊戲人間,劫富濟貧,往往連自已的銀子都散給災民。一日,他遇上一班強盜,打算搶劫一個正在保運一批價值連城珍寶的護衛。最初遊被他們欺騙一起劫鏢,但他在發覺後誓要進行報復。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The wandering swordsman Yu Hsieh Erh has formidable sword skills and helps the poor by robbing from thieves and distributing the wealth. He meets a group of bandits who are planning to rob a convoy escorting some valuables and is tricked into participating in the robbery. Yu soon realizes his folly and returns to take revenge on the bandits.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 歌舞團台柱陳君邁賦閒多時後,應徵當富家女梅倩如的司機,竟被誤傳戀情。倩如為查明流言的來源,假扮記者採訪歌舞團,期間君邁與倩如暗生好感,經過一番試探後,二人終一舞定情。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Peter was a key dancer in a dance troupe and applied to be the chauffeur of a rich girl, Betty. When he is rumoured to be her lover, Betty is furious and goes undercover as a reporter to investigate the rumour. They fall in love in the process, and after putting Peter through many tests, they finally seal their love with a dance.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 正氣凜然的劍客白一鵬向「冷血五祖」報仇,卻遭追打至殘廢。數年後,一位年青人巧遇躲在洞穴裡的白一鵬,白一鵬亦決定將追風劍法傳授給這位堅毅的年青人,以助他向「冷血五祖」復仇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A righteous swordsman, Bai Yi Pang, seeks revenge on an evil clan but is crippled after being beaten up by them. Years later, a young man encounters Bai who is hiding in a cave. Bai decides to teach this determined young man his Swift Sword skills so that he can help Bai take revenge on the evil clan.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 楊國良是探長兒子,國良怪父沉迷工作,母離世仍在查案,隔膜頓生。國良遇上舞女梅琳,兩人母親皆歿,了解下迅即同居生活。國良因生活費花盡到俱樂部賭錢,被陳彪騙下巨款,更強姦梅琳。國良憤然殺死陳彪,遭警察圍捕......
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kuo, a police’s son, blames his father for his mother’s death. He has no job, spends time in night clubs and always gets into fights. One night, Kuo rescues Mei from being raped and they become friends. Kuo wants to support Mei and her family so he goes gambling hoping to gain more money but bad luck seems to be following them with tragic outcomes.

epg.programme_title_en: New Tales of the Flying Fox
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述了號稱打遍天下無敵手的苗人鳳,與大俠胡一刀不打不相識又識英雄重英雄,在比武過程中中了奸計,苗誤殺了胡,胡妻亦為夫殉情。兒子胡斐長大後誓要報仇……斐先後邂逅袁紫衣,程靈素二女,發展一段無私的三角戀。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a great rendition of The Silver Fox and Legend of the Fox comes this exciting adventure, where the only thing between the clan leaders and certain death is Hui Ying-hung.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 記者仕泰爲發掘歌星小雲雀的秘密,假扮大亨接近小雲雀。後來仕泰的假大亨身份被揭穿,小雲雀大怒,請來真正大亨揭穿仕泰的身份。怎料大亨很欣賞仕泰的應變能力,實時聘請他爲助手,處理歌星登台事宜。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sixties pop star Carrie Ku plays the Little Lark in this romantic-drama of mistaken identity that is a treasure trove of some of the most popular Mandarin songs of all time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一幫土匪帶著劫來的保險箱到某小鎮,迫鐵匠韋開箱,韋卻逃走報官。匪幫濫殺村民,多名義士聞訊,聯手對抗眾匪。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of bandits flees with a stolen safe to a village where they oppress the villagers and force the blacksmith Wei to unlock the safe. Wei refuses and flees to report to officials, while heroes of the town emerge to fight the bandits.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部喜劇描述鄉下人阿牛來港後,因生性戇直而經常被壞人利用。阿牛嘗盡低下層社會的人情冷暖,最後更被判入獄!究竟天生樂觀的他,能否吉人天相?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南劍丁夢豪是「天下第一劍」,卻敗於路過的怪和尚。丁履行諾言,跟他苦修三年石工。丁修煉期滿返回家鄉後,仍有不少武林人士冒名找他決戰,唯丁欲隱居民間,所以堅拒一切挑戰。無奈後來卻要被逼與北劍再來一場生死決鬥,究竟最後會是鹿死誰手?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Southern Swordsman Ting is named “The Fastest Sword” but is defeated by a street monk and has to fulfil his promise of working on stone craving with the monk for three years. Ting returns home to lead a peaceful life after that and declines all fight challenges. Even so, he is forced to fight the Northern Swordsman. Who will win finally?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 軍閥割據時代,江湖人物及狡黠之徒所玩弄的傳統騙術層出不窮,「蛇神」、「李三腳」、「三隻手」等一群妖言惑眾的騙徒令人云亦云的愚民上釣,反映舊時代一切牛鬼蛇神眾生相。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述,萬勝鏢局總鏢頭陳華堂,懾於白眉道姑的威望,撫養對頭人焦家的兒子炎兒,卻不許其習武,炎兒遂偷練父傳之「烈焰刀法」。十年後,城中出現蒙面採花大盜,女捕快泠如霜特來偵查,並將炎兒擒獲;然而採花大盜,原來是陳之長子正豪,炎兒實遭陳氏父子嫁禍。炎兒越獄而逃,誓要洗脱罪名……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chan, the chief of Wan Sheng Escort, is forced to raise his opponent’s son, Yim. While Chan forbids Yim to practice martial arts, Yim secretly learns it. Ten years later, a rapist appears and Yim is arrested by a lady constable as the suspect. The rapist turns out to be Chan’s elder son and Yim is framed by the Chans. Can Yim prove his innocence?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兵部侍郎程浦將次女雪娥許配予好友之子穆居易,庶室程夫人既憤且惱,對居易訛稱長女雪雁乃雪娥,催促二人早日成親。居易見雪雁貌醜而癡,嚇得留書出走。富豪朱煥然對雪娥心儀已久,趁此良機冒充居易,依期迎親……本片由李香君、金峰分飾男、女主角,配搭新鮮;而蔣光超與莊元庸一胖一瘦的諧趣演出,更令人笑破肚皮。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friends son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 執到寶為武功了得的尋寶專家,因聞招九積自稱有張保仔寶藏之線索,乃往賭場將其救出;招云古董商人魯古董藏有張生前一批信札,執、招夜竊不遂,以敲碎古玩要脅,取得信札;惟信札字跡陳舊,僅認清法華寺字樣;彼時適逢高僧無相下山,執遂假扮瘋僧約無相談禪,招則暗闖其房搜尋秘密...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fans of the international star Alexander Fu Sheng were aghast. Their idol had broken both his legs and was recuperating. Everyone wondered: would he be able to return to the action comedies for which he was so famous? This movie was the answer, and it left no doubt that he had made a full recovery. Liu Chia-yung, brother of preeminent martial arts moviemaker Liu Chia-liang, was famous in his own right for kung-fu comedies, and he out-did himself with this one. Imagine Bob Hope and Bing Crosby with the skills of Jet Li and Jackie Chan, and you’ve got an idea of the fun and fury inherent in this delightful tale of two con men vying for a horde of hidden gold. Add to the mix a Shaolin monk (played by Master Killer Gordon Liu Chia-hui), a powerfully brutal villain, and his equally dangerous mute sister (future director Yang Tsing-tsing), and you’ve got one of the most internationally loved kung-fu capers ever made.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名土匪因助俄國抗擊日本而成為北方的大軍閥。由於他好大喜功又目不識丁,老百姓當他是個大笑話。後來,當年曾被他無端殺死的戲班老闆之女出現,槍殺了這個賣國賊。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A bandit became a warlord in northern China by helping Russia fight against Japan. Due to his ignorance and silly behaviour, he is seen as a joke to everyone. The warlord is finally killed by the daughter of a troupe master whom he had killed for no reason, bringing a befitting end to a traitor.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 正派「鐵旗門」與反派「神鷹堂」,一直對立。一次,「神鷹堂」堂主以向「鐵旗門」陪罪為辭,邀「鐵旗門」門主鐵麟偕弟子往總壇喝酒;鐵認為內中有詐,不宜前往,但大弟子曹風則力言將計就計,若彼等有所行動,就乘機將他們消滅,鐵允之。「神鷹堂」果然十面埋伏,鐵等將敵人逐一殲滅;惟鐵竟在混亂中遇害,卻未知死於誰手…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When super director Chang Cheh found new talent and blood with The Five Venoms actors, most of which were trained in the highly acrobatic Chinese opera and well versed with exotic martial arts weapons, this created a new spark for his use of bizarre weapons in his films. The Flag Of Iron is one of 20 movies that he directed featuring the utterly flabbergasting and physically exhausting action bits created by these five dudes. You have the good guys from the righteous clan versus the bad guys from the villainous clan and its so filled with dont-blink-or-you-will-miss-something gags, you will need to watch it over and over again so you can see the things you missed.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述茶居老闆女菁菁與伐木工羅貴生相戀,菁父聞說惡霸看中菁,忙找生籌備婚事;不料翌日生即奉命運送木材進城,只得與菁暫別。生進城後,鎮上即有謠言,說生已在城裡另訂親事;另一方面菁無意中發現惡霸向寡婦施暴,寡婦不甘受辱自殺,惡霸欲殺人滅口,菁身陷險境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A sweet inn-keeper’s daughter is witness to a perverted rape, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle. Can her true love rescue her in time? For this movie, the moonlight serenade is the sound of suspense, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 集賢武館主人平伯被日高手谷嵐所殺,其子鐵娃入山投靠大舌頭,與大之女紅蝴蝶相處甚歡。時穀之子剛自日學成歸來,挑撥大熊與鐵。後熊與剛決戰死於暗算;鐵與紅得悉,下山報仇...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A vicious Japanese judo expert wants to prove that Chinese are the “sick people of Asia” and sets out to sabotage and kill the best martial artists in dangerous tournaments. To save his son from this, the head of Ping Pai Boxing Institute sends him to the mountains to learn the powerful Thunderbolt Fist technique from master fighter, Red Butterfly.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 集賢武館主人平伯被日高手谷嵐所殺,其子鐵娃入山投靠大舌頭,與大之女紅蝴蝶相處甚歡。時穀之子剛自日學成歸來,挑撥大熊與鐵。後熊與剛決戰死於暗算;鐵與紅得悉,下山報仇...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A vicious Japanese judo expert wants to prove that Chinese are the “sick people of Asia” and sets out to sabotage and kill the best martial artists in dangerous tournaments. To save his son from this, the head of Ping Pai Boxing Institute sends him to the mountains to learn the powerful Thunderbolt Fist technique from master fighter, Red Butterfly.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清朝末年,光緒帝親政后,開始着手維新變法,惜改革觸犯了想保全自身富貴功名的官僚的阻擾。支持皇帝變法的康有為性格軟弱,堅持變法的譚嗣同難免浮躁,光緒深知自己的處境危險,於是企圖利用袁世凱去對付握有兵權的榮祿。但在關鍵時刻,袁世凱見風使舵卻向榮祿告了密,出賣了光緒...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxu’s enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位功夫師傅與三位門徒被惡霸欺淩,師徒俱敗於他拳下。三徒悲憤填膺,分別尋師學藝。半年後,惡霸壽辰之日,三徒連袂回歸,誓要與惡霸一較高下!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A kung fu master and his three students lost everything after they are floored by a bully. To take revenge, the students find ways to learn from other kung fu masters and come back six months later to have a rematch with the bully on their master’s birthday.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事背景為一幢女子公寓,房東陳太太痛恨男人,嚴禁男性進入,不幸,女房客卻多靠男性而活;歌女尤淑文由台北飛到香港,找尋失蹤的妹妹;尤經作曲家王德生介紹到居所樓上之女子公寓居住...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A Taiwanese singer comes to Hong Kong in search for her missing younger sister, who had arrived in Hong Kong to be discovered as a nightclub singer. She finds lodging at an apartment for women run by a man-hating landlady, Mrs Chan. However, Mrs Chan cannot confine the young ladies’ youthful vitality within the apartment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片講述洪熙官被投靠清廷之武林敗類高進忠追殺,身受重傷,市井英雄朱才、陳阿全、梁天寶安排洪藏身於豆腐店中,並為他買藥治傷。高進忠探得洪藏身之處,暗囑手下廣佈眼線,以便將洪一舉成擒...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hong Xi Guan of Shaolin is chased and wounded by a martial arts scum who took refuge in the Qing court. He is saved and healed by friends from the wet market and they hide Hong in a bean curd shop to protect him. However, Hong’s enemy finds him and ambushes him at the shop, hoping to capture Hong and all his friends.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 富家子卓明不顧父親反對,與歌女雪玲結婚,並因此與家庭斷絕關係。婚後,雪玲懷孕,卓明因過度勞累導致視力衰退。為維持家計,雪玲重操舊業登台演唱,而卓明不願拖累妻子,選擇悄然離開。在友人鼓勵下,雪玲再次公開獻唱,卓明深受感動,最終與妻兒重逢。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ming marries singer Ling, defying his wealthy father and severing family ties. When Ling becomes pregnant, Ming’s overwork causes him to lose his sight. To support their home, Ling returns to the stage but Ming leaves to avoid becoming a burden. Encouraged by a friend, Ling performs again, and her song moves Ming to reunite with his wife and child.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 黃飛鴻與天壽武館之王隱林年少氣盛,得罪陸正甫武館少主及其騁用的高手單雄,從而掀起武館間的正面衝突。本片是劉家良導演最得意的作品,更是1981年十大賣座電影之一。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The young Wong Fei Hung and his friend Wang Yin Lin offend the young master of another rival school and the expert they hire, causing both martial arts schools to fight against each other. This is Director Liu Chia Liang’s masterpiece and one of the top ten highest grossing movies in 1981.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 呂紫英陪同父呂天奇到台灣發展,兩姐白虹、青萍留港繼續歌舞生涯。白虹認識江慶良後投契相戀,江向老闆引薦白虹在歌劇中當主角,老父回來見三位女兒成就,開心不已。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廣東十虎之首的鐵橋三為人景仰,擁有徒弟無數。當時達官貴人都以吸食鴉片為時尚,而鐵橋三亦隨俗吸食,身子因此漸受毒害。後來,鐵橋三更被煙館主人擊敗,幸得徒弟捨身相救,他才不致喪命。於是,鐵橋三決心戒掉鴉片,重新振作。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tie Qiao San, head of the Ten Guangdong Tigers, is an honourable master with many disciples. As opium becomes popular among the nobles, Tie starts taking it and gradually harms his body. When an opium house’s owner defeats Tie in a fight and he is only saved from being killed by his disciple, Tie vows to quit opium and get back on his feet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這個故事洋溢著《羅密歐與茱麗葉》般的悲戀色彩。兩個世代積怨已深的家族,被一條遍佈鱷魚的河流阻隔,誰也不願築橋往來。然而,命運卻讓兩家子女在大學裡邂逅並深深相愛。為了相守,他們不僅必須跨越險惡的河流,更要化解兩個家族間延續多年的仇恨。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This story has a Romeo and Juliet flavour. Two families who hate each other live across the opposite sides of a river filled with crocodiles and do not bother to have a bridge built. Their respective children meet in university and fall in love, but have to find ways to be together and resolve the hatred between their families.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 俠女花碧蓮愛上鄰村的駱宏勛,其父花振芳去說親,卻遭駱母拒絕。碧蓮深心不忿,找上駱家,把宏勛打倒來消氣。後碧蓮為救人而得罪賭棍萬三句,萬率眾圍殺碧蓮,幸宏勛及時趕來相救。萬之主人王倫知悉一切後,重金收買知府,將宏勛打下冤獄。碧蓮往探監,見宏勛奄奄一息,遂隻身闖進王倫練武場,大戰眾強徒,並取下王倫助手首級。翌日,碧蓮把血淋淋的人頭掛在竹竿上,到市上去叫賣,結果驚動官差,被捉進衙門...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hua is an upright and brave swordswoman who will stand up against villains and do anything for Luo, the man she loves. When Luo is sent to jail by the corrupted police, she sets out to free him and did not hesitate to chop off two bodyguards’ heads. In the process, she also stumbles across an old enemy of her father who is back seeking revenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 秦鳳笙、鳳簫兄妹才情敏捷,滿腹經綸,卻常受繼母夏氏刻薄。鳳簫自幼許與李如龍為妻,夏氏貪圖富貴,強逼如龍退婚;如龍不肯,夏氏再施毒計誣告如龍偷盜,將其收在獄中。鳳簫為救如龍,與侍婢春蘭喬扮男裝上京,更以如龍之名赴考,一舉中恩科狀元。明世宗見鳳簫長得一表非凡,乃命相國為媒,招為駙馬。洞房之夕,鳳簫向公主言明真相,並說服公主,安排一條妙計…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hsiaos stepmother frames her fiancé Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to him. When Hsiao comes clean on their wedding night, she persuades the Princess to follow a plan…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片改編自七十年代知名小說家江之南的作品。故事描述,劉永被掠去財物,為生計打劫,開罪了歐陽幫,但幫主欣賞劉膽色,交上朋友來,後保鏢李麗麗對劉有好感,卻惹黑旗門胡妒忌…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Liu serves his triad society loyally and tries to live a respectable life, but over time his good intentions lead him to an all-out gang war with a startling conclusion.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名強盜和一位居無定所的賭徒合作以賭賺錢。一天,他們成功從叛國軍閥屋裡偷取一大筆金錢,途中卻遇上革命戰士,並希望他們能資助革命叛軍計劃。二人是否會用偷來的財富協助革命戰士?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A roadside bandit and a traveling gambler team up to make money from gambling. In a successful attempt to steal a huge amount of money from a warlord’s home, they encounter revolutionists who seek their help to fund the reform campaign. Will the two help the revolutionists’ cause with the stolen money?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以「趕屍」為業的陳師父與徒弟受託押運九具殭屍,啟程上路。未料途中兩具竟逃脫。其中一具實際上並非殭屍,而是為躲避敵人追殺而假扮的江湖豪客。更令人意外的是,此人與陳師父同樣身懷絕技,二人皆為深不可測的武林高手!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武林高手加入紅蓮花會,圖謀推翻暴君。總督追捕會眾,一名武者在爭奪商人之女的比武招親中墜入愛河,性別角色顛倒的武俠喜劇就此展開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Martial artists join Red Lotus Flower Society to overthrow evil emperor. Governor hunts society members. Kung fu practitioner falls for merchants daughter amid kung fu contest for her hand. Gender role reversal comedy ensues.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 戰火多年讓藍波身心俱疲,但他終於在一座寺院中找到了內心的平靜。當好友兼導師特勞特曼上校請求他協助執行一項前往阿富汗的最高機密任務時,藍波予以拒絕;然而當特勞特曼遭到擄捕後,藍波不得不重新考慮。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Combat has taken its toll on Rambo, but he’s finally begun to find inner peace in a monastery. When Rambo’s friend and mentor Col. Trautman asks for his help on a top secret mission to Afghanistan, Rambo declines but must reconsider when Trautman is

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位才華洋溢卻備受爭議的科學家,執著於打造具有人性智慧的機器,最終引發危險而不可預測的後果。這是一場科技與倫理的極限挑戰,也是一段關於人性與未來的深刻探討。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A brilliant but controversial research scientist becomes obsessed with his quest to create a humanistic machine, leading to a dangerous conclusion.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧斯卡金像獎®提名者西爾維斯特史泰龍主演的這部動作驚悚片,將帶您體驗腎上腺素飆升的快感,直到最後一格震撼人心的畫面!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Academy Award®-Nominee Sylvester Stallone stars in this explosive action-thriller that will keep you on the edge of your seat until the final, powerful frame!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿諾史瓦辛格在《魔鬼孩子王》中飾演強悍的偵探約翰金布爾,他臥底成為一名教師,以尋找毒梟的妻子。這部經典的喜劇驚悚片充滿了動作、幽默和感人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Arnold Schwarzenegger stars as tough detective John Kimble in Kindergarten Cop, going undercover as a teacher to find a drug lords wife. Packed with action, humor, and heart, it’s a classic comedy-thriller.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 憤世嫉俗的員工奧森厭惡他那些懶惰的同事。他發現了一間秘密的、神奇的辦公室,這間辦公室能顯著提升他的工作效率和地位,但他的同事們卻看不到這間辦公室,並因此對他的成功心生嫉妒。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Misanthropic worker Orson detests his lazy colleagues. He finds a secret, magical office that boosts his productivity and status, but his coworkers can’t see the room and grow to resent his success.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在戰後的日本,哥吉拉的出現為滿目瘡痍的國土帶來了新的浩劫。當軍方無力介入、政府束手無策之際,倖存者們必須在絕望中團結起來,迎戰這股無情的恐怖力量。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In postwar Japan, Godzilla brings new devastation to an already scorched landscape. With no military intervention or government help in sight, the survivors must join together in the face of despair and fight back against an unrelenting horror.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 尚-克勞德·范·達美在冰球賽中孤身對抗恐怖分子,誓死拯救副總統並阻止體育館爆炸!時間緊迫,他能撐到比賽結束嗎?這就是《驚爆點》!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jean-Claude Van Damme battles terrorists at a hockey game to save the Vice President and stop a stadium bombing in this explosive thriller. Can he stall the game long enough? It’s Sudden Death!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 戰火多年讓藍波身心俱疲,但他終於在一座寺院中找到了內心的平靜。當好友兼導師特勞特曼上校請求他協助執行一項前往阿富汗的最高機密任務時,藍波予以拒絕;然而當特勞特曼遭到擄捕後,藍波不得不重新考慮。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Combat has taken its toll on Rambo, but he’s finally begun to find inner peace in a monastery. When Rambo’s friend and mentor Col. Trautman asks for his help on a top secret mission to Afghanistan, Rambo declines but must reconsider when Trautman is

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 湯姆克魯斯主演的《神鬼傳奇》以驚險刺激的全新視角詮釋了這段傳奇故事。一位古代女王在現代甦醒,釋放出一股可怕的力量,引發了一場橫跨大洲的戰爭。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tom Cruise stars in The Mummy, a thrilling new take on the legend. When an ancient queen awakens in modern times, she unleashes a terrifying force, sparking a battle across continents.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 派屈克・貝特曼是一名在華爾街、於父親公司任職的年輕人,卻毫無理由地殺人。隨著日子一天天過去,他對世界的仇恨愈發強烈。這部極度黑暗的黑色喜劇改編自布雷特・伊斯頓・艾利斯的同名小說。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Patrick Bateman, a young man working on Wall Street at his fathers company kills for no reason at all. With each day, his hatred for the world becomes more and more intense. This incredibly dark comedy is based on the book by Bret Easton Ellis.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 昆汀・塔倫提諾第八部作品,背景設定於寒冷的懷俄明州,八名陌生人——包括兩名賞金獵人與一名通緝犯——在暴風雪中被迫聚在一起,對抗天候,也彼此對立。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Quentin Tarantino’s 8th film takes place in wintry Wyoming, where eight strangers, including two bounty hunters and a wanted fugitive, find themselves battling the elements and each other.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 憤世嫉俗的員工奧森厭惡他那些懶惰的同事。他發現了一間秘密的、神奇的辦公室,這間辦公室能顯著提升他的工作效率和地位,但他的同事們卻看不到這間辦公室,並因此對他的成功心生嫉妒。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Misanthropic worker Orson detests his lazy colleagues. He finds a secret, magical office that boosts his productivity and status, but his coworkers can’t see the room and grow to resent his success.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Miami Vice, undercover detectives played by Jamie Foxx and Colin Farrell navigate danger, crime, and seduction in a gritty, stylish update of the iconic TV series. Also stars Gong Li.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩名在越戰中陣亡的士兵多年後被改造成半人半機的超級戰士。然而,當記憶逐漸甦醒,他們掙脫束縛,在昔日戰友之間展開了一場殘酷的對決。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two soldiers killed in Vietnam are revived years later as cyborg super-soldiers. But when memories return, they break free—setting up a brutal showdown between former comrades.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《邁阿密風雲》中,由傑米・福克斯與柯林・法洛飾演的臥底警探深入毒品世界,在危險、誘惑與犯罪中周旋。這部風格鮮明、緊張刺激的作品重新演繹經典影集,同時由鞏俐聯袂主演。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Miami Vice, undercover detectives played by Jamie Foxx and Colin Farrell navigate danger, crime, and seduction in a gritty, stylish update of the iconic TV series. Also stars Gong Li.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名美國背包客作為司機捲入一個毒品走私團夥,他最終要穿過慕尼黑高速公路逃離僱主的追捕。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An American backpacker gets involved with a ring of drug smugglers as their driver, though he winds up on the run from his employers across Munichs high-speed Autobahn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《戰艦世紀》中,地球與強大的外星勢力展開一場橫跨海洋、天空與陸地的激烈戰鬥。由彼得·柏格執導,連恩尼遜、泰勒克奇與蕾哈娜領銜主演,呈現震撼爆炸級的海上動作鉅片。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Battleship, Earth battles a powerful alien force across sea, sky, and land. Directed by Peter Berg and starring Liam Neeson, Taylor Kitsch, and Rihanna, its explosive action at sea.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《戰艦世紀》中,地球與強大的外星勢力展開一場橫跨海洋、天空與陸地的激烈戰鬥。由彼得·柏格執導,連恩尼遜、泰勒克奇與蕾哈娜領銜主演,呈現震撼爆炸級的海上動作鉅片。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Battleship, Earth battles a powerful alien force across sea, sky, and land. Directed by Peter Berg and starring Liam Neeson, Taylor Kitsch, and Rihanna, its explosive action at sea.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《反恐戰場》中,傑米福克斯率領一支菁英FBI小組前往沙烏地阿拉伯追捕一名恐怖分子——這是一場文化與正義的緊張交鋒。該片由彼得柏格執導,麥可曼監製。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jamie Foxx leads an elite FBI team to hunt a terrorist in Saudi Arabia in The Kingdom—a tense clash of cultures and justice, directed by Peter Berg and produced by Michael Mann.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 派屈克・貝特曼是一名在華爾街、於父親公司任職的年輕人,卻毫無理由地殺人。隨著日子一天天過去,他對世界的仇恨愈發強烈。這部極度黑暗的黑色喜劇改編自布雷特・伊斯頓・艾利斯的同名小說。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Patrick Bateman, a young man working on Wall Street at his fathers company kills for no reason at all. With each day, his hatred for the world becomes more and more intense. This incredibly dark comedy is based on the book by Bret Easton Ellis.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 湯姆克魯斯主演的《神鬼傳奇》以驚險刺激的全新視角詮釋了這段傳奇故事。一位古代女王在現代甦醒,釋放出一股可怕的力量,引發了一場橫跨大洲的戰爭。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tom Cruise stars in The Mummy, a thrilling new take on the legend. When an ancient queen awakens in modern times, she unleashes a terrifying force, sparking a battle across continents.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 爭取脫離英國統治、追求獨立的民眾,遭到軍隊鎮壓,引發一場血腥暴動,而政府隨後加以掩蓋。超過一百名馬爾他人被誣陷為暴力事件的煽動者,遭到不公正的監禁。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Citizens fighting for independence from Britain were met by an Army-quelled bloody riot that the government covered up. Over 100 Maltese were falsely jailed for instigating the violence.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 真人真事改編,維奧拉戴維斯領銜主演這部動作連場的電影,講述一支全女班精英戰士組成的隊伍決心保家衛國。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Inspired by true events, Viola Davis stars in an action-packed story of an elite all-female unit of warriors determined to defend their nation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位才華洋溢卻備受爭議的科學家,執著於打造具有人性智慧的機器,最終引發危險而不可預測的後果。這是一場科技與倫理的極限挑戰,也是一段關於人性與未來的深刻探討。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A brilliant but controversial research scientist becomes obsessed with his quest to create a humanistic machine, leading to a dangerous conclusion.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部電影取材自二戰真實事件,講述了一支美國潛艦小隊奉命捕捉一艘載有恩尼格瑪密碼機的德國U型潛艇的故事。一場充滿緊張、欺騙與生存挑戰的水下動作驚悚之戰即將展開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Inspired by real WWII events, this film follows an American submarine crew tasked with capturing a German U-boat carrying the Enigma code machine. A tense, underwater action thriller full of deception, danger, and survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傑瑞德・巴特勒與尼可拉・科斯特-瓦爾道主演,化身彼此對立的諸神,展開一場決定宇宙命運的史詩對決,震撼人心的奇幻冒險。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gerard Butler and Nikolaj Coster-Waldau star as rival gods locked in an epic battle to decide the fate of the universe in this thrilling fantasy-adventure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在戰後的日本,哥吉拉的出現為滿目瘡痍的國土帶來了新的浩劫。當軍方無力介入、政府束手無策之際,倖存者們必須在絕望中團結起來,迎戰這股無情的恐怖力量。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In postwar Japan, Godzilla brings new devastation to an already scorched landscape. With no military intervention or government help in sight, the survivors must join together in the face of despair and fight back against an unrelenting horror.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《遺落戰境》中,湯姆・克魯斯飾演一名在未來地球踏上救贖之旅的男子。由《創:光速戰記》導演執導,這是一部視覺震撼、直面過去以拯救人類的科幻冒險。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In *Oblivion*, Tom Cruise stars as a man on a journey of redemption in a future Earth. Directed by the creator of *TRON: Legacy*, it’s a visually stunning sci-fi adventure about confronting the past to save humanity.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 爭取脫離英國統治、追求獨立的民眾,遭到軍隊鎮壓,引發一場血腥暴動,而政府隨後加以掩蓋。超過一百名馬爾他人被誣陷為暴力事件的煽動者,遭到不公正的監禁。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 麥特戴蒙回歸,再次飾演傑森伯恩,保羅葛林格拉斯執導的《神鬼認證:傑森包恩》也將繼續上演驚險刺激的續集。伯恩被迫重出江湖,與艾莉西亞·維坎德、文森特·卡塞爾等眾多明星聯袂出擊,共同面對新的危機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Matt Damon returns as Jason Bourne in Jason Bourne, with director Paul Greengrass back for another thrilling chapter. Bourne is drawn out of hiding, facing new dangers with Alicia Vikander, Vincent Cassel, and more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: A man takes his revenge on the family responsible for his wrongful sentence to ten years of hard labor.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A man takes his revenge on the family responsible for his wrongful sentence to ten years of hard labor.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: A South American quasi-revolutionary/guerilla/terrorist and a misled, admiring girl compatriot manage to kidnap the U.S. President during a diplomatic visit to Toronto. With a nondescript armored truck, crudely yet somehow elaborately rigged with high explosives (and the President trapped inside), the two terrorists keep the Secret Service at bay until in the end, Assanti is killed and Shatner has to find a way into the truck anyway.

One day he discovers he needs a permit to operate his boat so goes off to the big city to get one. On the way he witnesses television, crooks and many delights for the first time as well as falling in love.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: A professional killer, Jeff Costello, executes a nightclub owner on orders from the mob. He is caught in a police dragnet and arrested, but witnesses fail to identify him. Costello is released by the police, but remains their prime suspect. The mob, hearing of his arrest, fear being involved and order him silenced before he can talk. Using information supplied by his girlfriend, he kills the hit man sent after him. Ultimately, the police corner him in a crowed nightclub where he is killed in a bloody gun battle.
