epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 溫哥華島的野生太平洋海岸是卑詩省西海岸的一片古老而崎嶇的風貌。從久遠高山冰川的冰封山峰到加拿大濃霧蓋頂的唯一雨林,它是北美最潮濕的地方,這片原始的棲息地,既是太平洋的命脈,亦是大自然與人文精神共存之地。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Journey to the wild Pacific coast on the western shore of Vancouver Island in British Columbia. From the peaks of mountain glaciers to the canopies of Canada’s only rainforest, nature and human spirit coexist in spectacular habitats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從古至今,很多物種都被絕種危機所威脅。就如強極一時的恐龍帝國,亦在地球上消失殆盡。但另外一些則從滅絕邊緣生存下來,慢慢恢復甚至在自然界中建立王國。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Over the course of recorded time, many species have been threatened with extinction. Once-powerful animal empires – like the dinosaurs - have been completely wiped from the planet. But others once on the verge of disappearance have survived, bounced back, and even reclaimed their kingdoms.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在馬達加斯加偏遠的伯倫蒂保育區,兩個環尾狐猴派別因正面臨旱季日益嚴峻的挑戰而拉起戰幔。這些魅力非凡的狐猴僅在馬達加斯加島上被發現,黑白相間的尾巴十分突出,牠們活在女權體制中,每個幫派都有嚴格的等級制度,並擁有各自嚴守的領土。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the dry season approaches, tensions rise on Lemur Island, both between rival gangs and within their own ranks. Get a view from the battlefield as the female leaders fiercely defend their turf, while their newborn infants cling to them for safety.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在馬達加斯加偏遠的貝倫地保育區,旱季正對當地的環尾狐猴造成巨大的損耗。隨著覓食的難度增加,對立幫派領導人姬絲圖和嘉緹之間的關係越發緊張。隨著食物和水源日益稀缺,入侵者亦出現在附近。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As food and water become scarce, Crystal, the fierce leader of the Ruins gang, sets her sights on rival Kati’s territory and its neighboring fruit trees. Watch as Crystal’s move and a raid by outside invaders lead to dire consequences for one troop.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與位處北方的科學家團隊一起熬夜,他們嘗試為一隻公牛鯊裝上追蹤儀,看看這頭夜貓子入夜後有何行蹤。然後與南方團隊一起潛入80米深的海底,並嘗試為一條雌性大白鯊裝上衛星追蹤器。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stay up late as the northern team attaches an activity tag to a bull shark and finds out what this night owl does after sunset. Then dive 80 meters deep with the southern team, who are hoping to put a satellite tracker on a female great white.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在哥倫比亞中心的熱帶雨林中長大,一隻年輕的捲尾猴必須掌握牠的攀爬技巧,學習如何尋找食物,又要學會區分敵友。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Growing up in the rainforests in the heart of Colombia, a young capuchin monkey has to master his climbing skills, learn how to find food and learn to distinguish friend from foe.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 尚比亞的卡桑卡國家公園是一個不尋常狒狒種類的家園。狒狒有點背棄了通常與這些大型猴子相關的主導地位的攻擊性,並開展更和平的生活。與牠們生活的是一支專門的研究團隊,他們的任務是揭示這些狒狒的秘密,並瞭解是什麼讓牠們變成這樣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From Colombia’s high plains of the Páramo to its tropical forests, hummingbirds have evolved into an extraordinary number of species. Whether battling freezing rain or jungle predators, each mother must struggle to build a nest, protect her eggs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 來認識這些異常的微型動物,牠們利用嬌小的身軀在世上最致命的環境中克險求生。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the extraordinary miniature animals, who use their small size to survive against all odds in the world’s most deadly environments.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 體型異常龐大的動物就需要異常的適應力。從巨大的鯨魚到森林怪物,這些就是自然巨人的史詩式生存故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Extraordinarily large animals need extraordinary adaptations. From mighty whales to forest monsters, these are the epic survival stories of nature’s giants.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 日入而作可帶來極端的挑戰,同時亦帶來巨大的機會。在這沒有光的世界,危險在每個角落蟄伏。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Living your life at night can present extreme challenges - and massive opportunities. In this world without light, danger lurks around every corner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 來認識這些異常的微型動物,牠們利用嬌小的身軀在世上最致命的環境中克險求生。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the extraordinary miniature animals, who use their small size to survive against all odds in the world’s most deadly environments.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 體型異常龐大的動物就需要異常的適應力。從巨大的鯨魚到森林怪物,這些就是自然巨人的史詩式生存故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Extraordinarily large animals need extraordinary adaptations. From mighty whales to forest monsters, these are the epic survival stories of nature’s giants.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 偷獵危機加劇,偷獵者將注意力轉向孤兒們。四周大的牙美拿失去母親後終於在犀牛孤兒院找到庇護。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The poaching crisis intensifies and poachers turn their attention to orphanages. After losing her mother, four-week-old Jamila finally finds sanctuary at The Rhino Orphanage.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野外的一年: 約克郡 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 春天來臨。北約克沼澤國家公園裡的動物必須尋找食物、配偶,並組織家庭。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spring comes to the Dales and North York Moors National Parks, the season when the parks animals must find food, a mate and raise a family.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野外的一年: 約克郡 #2
epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 反常的寒冷夏天令約克郡谷地和北約克沼澤國家公園的幾種動物生活艱難,其中包括一隻受傷的西方狍和她的雙胞胎。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Unseasonably cold summer weather causes difficulties for several animals in the Yorkshire Dales and North York Moors, including an injured roe deer and her twins.

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #6
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是最後衝刺,馬努的名單只剩下一個國家。美國作為他冒險的最後一站提供了令人驚嘆的美食體驗。環遊世界。三十天。花費20,000美元。馬努能夢想成真嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is the home stretch with just one more country on Manus list. America offers amazing food experiences on his final leg of his adventure. Around the world. Thirty days. $20,000 to spend. Will Manu achieve his dream?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫南非美食之旅的第一站是繁華的開普敦。他在當地到訪熱鬧的農貿市場,並在 保卡烹調開普馬來咖哩。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren’s first stop on his food trail of South Africa is the bustling city of Cape Town. Here, he visits a lively farmers market and cooks up a Cape Malay Curry in Bo Kaap.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫沿著南非海岸角繼續他的美食之旅,在抵達大森林私人自然保護區前,先到訪卡耶利沙黑人區,那裡是一些具啟發性的微型農業提案的集中地。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren continues his food trail along South Africa’s Cape Coast, stopping off at the township of Khayelitsha, home to some inspiring micro-farming initiatives, before arriving at Grootbos Private Nature Reserve.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫前往開普酒鄉,品嚐一系列當地的葡萄酒,包括南非標誌性紅酒皮諾塔吉和獨特而複雜的加烈葡萄酒華塔菲亞。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren heads to the Cape Winelands, where he tastes a variety of local wines including Pinotage, a signature South African red, and Ratafia, a unique and complex fortified wine.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫美食之旅的下一站是位於卡拉哈里沙漠中心的提斯瓦魯豪華私人野生動物保護區。然後他遇到名廚馬努斯,烹製一些刺激的南非美食。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren’s next stop on his food trail is Tswalu Nature Reserve, in the heart of the Kalahari Desert. Warren then meets with acclaimed Chef Marnus to cook up some exciting South African delicacies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 訪問茱莉亞蘿勃茲所演的《風月俏佳人》服裝設計師瑪莉蓮凡斯、《傲氣蓋天》製作人史蒂芬胡利、《荷里活報道》的史葛芬伯格等人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Julia Roberts’ Pretty Woman costume designer Marilyn Vance, Michael Collins producer Stephen Woolley, The Hollywood Reporter’s Scott Feinberg, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 訪問湯姆漢克斯所演的《盜海狙擊》製作人丹拿般力堤、《紅粉聯盟》製作人艾略特雅培、好友兼演員佐治麥奎亞等人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Tom Hanks’ Captain Phillips producer Dana Brunetti, A League Of Their Own producer Elliot Abbott, friend and actor George Maguire, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 訪問惠妮休斯頓所演的《護花傾情》導演米克傑克遜、音樂家榮連西、《傳教士之妻》製作人艾略特雅培等人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Whitney Houston’s The Bodyguard director Mick Jackson, musician Wayne Linsey, The Preacher’s Wife producer Elliot Abbott, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今集,動物園在沼澤森林歡迎兩隻鱷魚,新的東南亞棲息地開張,團隊準備為南方白犀牛寶寶慶生。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, the Zoo welcomes two crocodiles to the Swamp Forest, the new South East Asia habitat opens and the team prepare for the birth of a baby southern white rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的靈長類小組準備迎接新生。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s primate team prepare to welcome a new birth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這個令人驚嘆的系列以前所未有的方式揭開《貓頭鷹的秘密生活》,使用特殊的綁定攝影機在春、夏、冬季跟蹤雅息士郡鄉村荒野角落的貓頭鷹家族。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This stunning series uncovers The Secret Life Of Owls as never seen before, using a special camera rig to follow families of owls in a wild corner of rural Essex, through winter, spring and summer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這個令人驚嘆的系列以前所未有的方式揭開《貓頭鷹的秘密生活》,使用特殊的綁定攝影機在春、夏、冬季跟蹤雅息士郡鄉村荒野角落的貓頭鷹家族。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站: 中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美、最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物、200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination China will take the audience to some of Yunnans most beautiful and stunning landscapes and homes to around 6000 species of plants, 200 mammals and 500 species of birds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站: 中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美、最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物、200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination China will take the audience to some of Yunnans most beautiful and stunning landscapes and homes to around 6000 species of plants, 200 mammals and 500 species of birds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《納萊迪: 小象故事》講述一隻救助中心小象孤兒的旅程,被委以她生存重任的男人在奮力拯救她生命的同時,也要為保護整個物種而爭分奪秒。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Naledi follows the journey of a baby elephant orphaned in a rescue camp, as the man tasked with her survival races to protect an entire species while fighting to save her life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以當時報導「山姆之子」的方式呈現事件,讓你沉浸在這謀殺案的戲劇中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Immerse yourself in the drama of the Son of Sam murders, presented the way the events were covered at the time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》檢視全球生物圈所面臨的存亡威脅,以及對地球和奧特亞羅瓦(紐西蘭)的未來代表著甚麼。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edge of Existence examines existential threats to the worlds biosphere and what it means for the future of the planet, and Aotearoa.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》探索人類有史以來面臨的最大存亡風險之一的未來- 一個生化威脅。從病毒到人造流行病和合成生化武器,科技正加速人造威脅的風險。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edge of Existence explores a future where bio-threats present one of the greatest existential risks that humanity has ever faced. From viruses to man-made pandemics and synthetic bio-weapons, technology is accelerating the risks of man-made threats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從時尚之都米蘭出發,渡過威尼斯大運河,到達脫俗的多羅米提山脈和色彩繽紛的五漁村海岸,以前所未有的方式從空中探索義大利北部。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Journey from the fashion capital to Milan, across the great canals of Venice to the otherworldly peaks of the Dolomites and the colorful coast of Cinque Terre to discover Northern Italy like never before - from the air.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 它們的形狀和大小各適其適,是可怕的火山、偉大的古代文明,還有地球上最清澈水域的家。它們就是迷人的義大利島國。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: They come in all shapes and sizes, are home to terrifying volcanoes, magnificent ancient civilizations, and some of the bluest waters on Earth. These are the fascinating worlds of Italys Islands.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從時尚之都米蘭出發,渡過威尼斯大運河,到達脫俗的多羅米提山脈和色彩繽紛的五漁村海岸,以前所未有的方式從空中探索義大利北部。

epg.programme_title_tc: 野外的一年: 約克郡 #2
epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 反常的寒冷夏天令約克郡谷地和北約克沼澤國家公園的幾種動物生活艱難,其中包括一隻受傷的西方狍和她的雙胞胎。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Unseasonably cold summer weather causes difficulties for several animals in the Yorkshire Dales and North York Moors, including an injured roe deer and her twins.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野外的一年: 約克郡 #3
epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夏季持續,秋天暫且未到,出人意料的宜人天氣為西方狍們提供了一條救命稻草,因牠們正為即將到來的冬季做準備。至於其他動物,交配季節已到,在文斯卡海灘充滿了睾酮的氣息。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Autumn is on hold as summer continues, with unexpectedly balmy conditions throwing a life line to the roe deer as they prepare for the winter ahead. For other animals, mating season has arrived, making for a testosterone-fuelled time at Ravenscar Beach.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野外的一年: 約克郡 #4
epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 儘管冬季遲來,但對文斯卡海灘的灰海豹來說,冬天就代表著分娩的時間。新生的幼崽現正快速步入成年,在牠們的母親繼續前行前,只有三周的時間來盡量增加體重。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Despite its delayed arrival, for the Grey Seals at Ravenscar Beach winter means it is time to give birth. The newborn pups are now on the fast track to adulthood, with just three weeks to gain as much weight as possible before their mothers move on.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫前往開普酒鄉,品嚐一系列當地的葡萄酒,包括南非標誌性紅酒皮諾塔吉和獨特而複雜的加烈葡萄酒華塔菲亞。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren heads to the Cape Winelands, where he tastes a variety of local wines including Pinotage, a signature South African red, and Ratafia, a unique and complex fortified wine.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫美食之旅的下一站是位於卡拉哈里沙漠中心的提斯瓦魯豪華私人野生動物保護區。然後他遇到名廚馬努斯,烹製一些刺激的南非美食。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren’s next stop on his food trail is Tswalu Nature Reserve, in the heart of the Kalahari Desert. Warren then meets with acclaimed Chef Marnus to cook up some exciting South African delicacies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫前往沿海城市德班 - 住在標誌性的蠔盒酒店。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren heads to the coastal city of Durban - where he’s staying at the iconic Oyster Box hotel.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在德班,華倫先到訪著名的麥士生活品味餐廳,享受任性的祖魯烤肉體驗,再與當地導遊浮高碰面,參觀附近一條祖魯村莊。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Durban, Warren visits the famous restaurant Max’s Lifestyle for an indulgent Shisa Nyama experience, before meeting with local guide Thoko to visit a nearby Zulu village.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫美食之行的下一站是克魯格國家公園,南非其中一個最大的野生動物保護區,他住在著名的沙比沙比旅館。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren’s next stop on his food trail is Kruger National Park, one of South Africa’s largest game reserves, where he’s staying at the renowned Sabi Sabi lodge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在喀拉哈里沙漠的中心發現無數的非洲動物,並學習製作傳統麵包乾來配早晨咖啡。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of the Kalahari Desert, Warren spots a myriad of African animals, and learns to make traditional rusks to go with his morning coffee.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 訪問惠妮休斯頓所演的《護花傾情》導演米克傑克遜、音樂家榮連西、《傳教士之妻》製作人艾略特雅培等人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Whitney Houston’s The Bodyguard director Mick Jackson, musician Wayne Linsey, The Preacher’s Wife producer Elliot Abbott, plus many more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 訪問湯姆克魯斯的特技指導韋德伊士活、《勇者無敵》聯合主演比利范贊、《夜訪吸血鬼》製作人史蒂芬胡利等人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Features interviews with Tom Cruise’s stunt coordinator Wade Eastwood, Taps co-star Billy Van Zandt, Interview With The Vampire producer Stephen Woolley, plus many more.

epg.programme_title_tc: 紅粉佳人: 無所畏懼
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: P!nk 是流行與搖滾樂壇的強大存在。雖然她最初被視為九○年代末眾多青少年流行歌手之一,但她最終開創了屬於自己的音樂風格,並穩固了無可取代的地位。她,是當今樂壇不可忽視的力量。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Pink is a powerhouse of pop and rock music. Although initially seen as yet another act in the late 90’s crowd of teen pop acts, she has since gone on to define her own genre and solidified her place as a standout from the rest. She is a force to be reckoned with in the music scene.

epg.programme_title_tc: 馬修派瑞: 不只是朋友
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬修派瑞因飾演昌德賓一角而深受觀眾喜愛,作為一位值得珍惜的老友和人,人們通過強調他在片場內外的喜劇遺產和個人奮鬥的珍藏片段緬懷他。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Matthew Perry, beloved for his role as Chandler Bing, is remembered through archive footage highlighting his comedic legacy and personal struggles, both on and off set, as a cherished friend and human being.

epg.programme_title_tc: 羅賓·威廉斯: 笑容下的淚
epg.programme_title_en: Robin Williams: Laugh Until You Cry
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這位喜劇泰斗有著令人驚嘆的頭腦,還有一系列讓我們嘖嘖稱奇的才華。他的故事激勵我們看穿那些看似擁有完美人生的人的面具。 他的精神將一直承傳。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The comic genius with an electric mind, with a range of talent that left us breathless. His story inspires us to look past the mask of those people who seem to have a perfect life. His legacy lives on.

epg.programme_title_tc: 約翰·希南: 摔角冠軍
epg.programme_title_en: John Cena: Champion Of The Ring
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莊先拿在繼「巨石」強森- 狄維莊遜後轉戰荷里活之前,叱吒摔角界十多年。無論是演戲還是摔跤,他都遵守自己的座右銘: 努力、忠誠、尊重。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: John Cena dominated wrestling for over a decade before transitioning to Hollywood, following Dwayne The Rock Johnson. Whether acting or wrestling, he lives by his mantra: Hustle, Loyalty, and Respect.

epg.programme_title_tc: 凱莉安德伍: 南方福音
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從奧克拉荷馬州契科塔的小鎮農場出發,走上世界最大舞台——凱莉.安德伍的旅程,是一個關於夢想、歌聲,以及無法被忽視的熱情的故事。這就是凱莉.安德伍的傳奇——從美國甜心蛻變為當代樂壇的活傳奇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From a small-town farm in Checotah, Oklahoma, to the biggest stages in the world — Carrie Underwood’s journey is the story of a dream, a voice, and a fire that couldn’t be ignored. This is the story of Carrie Underwood — the all-American girl who became a living legend.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《史汀: 自強不息》是一部引人入勝的紀錄片,深入探索這位音樂史上最具代表性人物之一的多面人生。影片以前所未有的視角,帶領觀眾走進一位音樂傳奇的內心世界,展現他的藝術如何持續啟發並挑戰世界。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sting: Ever Evolving is an enthralling documentary that delves into the multifaceted life of one of musics most iconic figures. The documentary offers an unprecedented glimpse into the mind of a musical legend, showcasing how his art continues to inspire and challenge the world.

epg.programme_title_tc: 凱特溫斯蕾: 天生女主角
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 因《鐵達尼號》而聞名的奧斯卡得主琦溫斯莉因在荷里活猛片和獨立電影中多變而激烈的演技而受讚譽,使她穩佔同代最優秀演員一席位。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Oscar-winner Kate Winslet, known for Titanic, is celebrated for her versatile, intense performances in both Hollywood blockbusters and indie films, cementing her as one of the finest actors of her generation.

epg.programme_title_tc: 紅粉佳人: 無所畏懼

She is a force to be reckoned with in the music scene.

epg.programme_title_tc: 妮可基嫚:  走向奧斯卡
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部專題紀錄片聚焦澳洲傳奇 Nicole Kidman 的早年生活、電影事業,以及她所經歷的高低起伏。從叢林中的聖誕節到奧斯卡得主,她的故事充滿啟發與考驗。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Feature documentary about the early life, filmic career, and trials and tribulations of Australian icon, Nicole Kidman. From a Bush Christmas to Oscar winning performances, her story is one of inspiration and hardship.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走進 Cher 的世界——這位歷久不衰的傳奇人物,從平凡起步到超級巨星,她的旅程在五十多年來深刻影響了流行文化。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Step into the world of Cher, an enduring icon whose journey from humble beginnings to superstardom has shaped pop culture for over five decades

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 它們的形狀和大小各適其適,是可怕的火山、偉大的古代文明,還有地球上最清澈水域的家。它們就是迷人的義大利島國。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: They come in all shapes and sizes, are home to terrifying volcanoes, magnificent ancient civilizations, and some of the bluest waters on Earth. These are the fascinating worlds of Italys Islands.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這裡擁有地中海一些最美麗的希臘神廟、似乎漂浮在海上的城市,還有地球上其中一個威力最大的火山,義大利這地區感覺就如平行世界。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With some of the most beautiful Greek temples on the Mediterranean, cities that just seem to float above the sea, and one of the most powerful volcanoes on Earth, this region of Italy feels like another world.

epg.programme_title_tc: 馬修派瑞: 不只是朋友
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬修派瑞因飾演昌德賓一角而深受觀眾喜愛,作為一位值得珍惜的老友和人,人們通過強調他在片場內外的喜劇遺產和個人奮鬥的珍藏片段緬懷他。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 來認識這些異常的微型動物,牠們利用嬌小的身軀在世上最致命的環境中克險求生。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the extraordinary miniature animals, who use their small size to survive against all odds in the world’s most deadly environments.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 體型異常龐大的動物就需要異常的適應力。從巨大的鯨魚到森林怪物,這些就是自然巨人的史詩式生存故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Extraordinarily large animals need extraordinary adaptations. From mighty whales to forest monsters, these are the epic survival stories of nature’s giants.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 日入而作可帶來極端的挑戰,同時亦帶來巨大的機會。在這沒有光的世界,危險在每個角落蟄伏。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Living your life at night can present extreme challenges - and massive opportunities. In this world without light, danger lurks around every corner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫美食之行的下一站是克魯格國家公園,南非其中一個最大的野生動物保護區,他住在著名的沙比沙比旅館。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren’s next stop on his food trail is Kruger National Park, one of South Africa’s largest game reserves, where he’s staying at the renowned Sabi Sabi lodge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在喀拉哈里沙漠的中心發現無數的非洲動物,並學習製作傳統麵包乾來配早晨咖啡。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of the Kalahari Desert, Warren spots a myriad of African animals, and learns to make traditional rusks to go with his morning coffee.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫來到歷史名城比勒陀利亞,到訪當地農夫市集,與糕點師郎高斯一起製作扭麻條(南非糯冬甩)。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren stops off at the historic city of Pretoria, where he visits the local farmers markets and cooks Koeksisters - South African sticky donuts - with Pastry Chef Nonkosi.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在繁忙的約翰內斯堡的第一站就是充滿活力的索維托小鎮。導遊仙迪帶他乘坐篤篤車​​遊覽,並烹煮了他自己版本的一道南非素菜- 恰卡拉卡。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren is in the bustling city of Johannesburg, and his first stop is the vibrant township of Soweto. He’s taken on a tuk tuk tour by his guide Sindi, and cooks up his version of Chakalala, a South African vegetable relish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 起司大師阿弗林・普里斯汀的起司探險之旅從阿爾卑斯山國瑞士展開,這裡是格魯耶爾與經典孔洞艾門塔起司的故鄉。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cheese Master Afrim Pristine begins his cheese expedition in the Alpine country of Switzerland, home of iconic classics like Gruyere and holey Swiss Emmental.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #8
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣在費城的街道、隧道、軌道和電車修車庫中與團隊並肩合作,使美國最大、最古老的大眾交通系統之一暢順並準時運作。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Philadelphia, Mike Davidson is on streets, in tunnels, on tracks and in trolley restoration garages - working shoulder-to-shoulder with the team that keeps one of Americas largest and oldest mass transit systems running smoothly and on time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從巨型媒體帝國的女繼承人到被通緝的重犯,見證1974年的派蒂赫茲綁架奇案。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From heiress of a giant media empire to wanted felon, witness the strange saga of the Patty Hearst kidnapping of 1974.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以當時報導「山姆之子」的方式呈現事件,讓你沉浸在這謀殺案的戲劇中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Immerse yourself in the drama of the Son of Sam murders, presented the way the events were covered at the time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明在日本發現了一連串樂趣。在寒冷的北海道北島上,他品嚐了海膽、池沼公魚和精緻的芝士蛋糕。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw discovers a host of delights in Japan. On the wintry northern island of Hokkaido, he samples sea urchin, pond smelt and boutique cheesecake.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明與漁民們一起出海,抓捕到所謂的「百萬金槍」。他還遇到一位在2011年海嘯中救了他員工的豉油製造商。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam goes to sea with the fishermen who caught the so-called `million-dollar tuna. He also meets a soy sauce maker who saved his staff from the 2011 tsunami.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明繼續他的日本烹飪之旅,準備新鮮的壽司,並前往妻子家鄉沉醉一些家鄉滋味。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw continues his culinary tour of Japan, preparing fresh sushi and taking a trip to his wifes hometown to indulge in a little home cooking.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明繼續他的日本烹飪朝聖之旅,品嚐一些最頂級的味噌、名古屋雞肉和和牛,並認識了一位年屆74歲的採鮑潛水員。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw continues his culinary pilgrimage in Japan, devouring some of the finest miso, Nagoya chicken and Wagyu beef, and meeting a 74-year-old abalone diver.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明在東京廣闊的城市版圖中探索一種飲食文化,它不僅維持了「工薪族」的風格,還保留了其烹飪傳統。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the vast urban sprawl of Tokyo, Adam Liaw explores a food culture that not only sustains the `salaryman workers in style but retains culinary traditions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明查訪了一些東京的瘋狂美食餐廳,品嚐了一些有趣的菜式,包括用雞的生殖器官製成的日式烤雞串。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw checks out the restaurants of food-crazy Tokyo and tastes some interesting dishes including Yakitori made from the reproductive organs of chickens.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明在蓬勃發展傳統文化的京都遇到了一位茗茶大師、一位藝伎和一位將義大利飯變成壽司的米芝蓮大廚。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam meets a tea master, a Maiko, and a Michelin chef who turns risotto into sushi in the thriving traditional culture of Kyoto.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明探索日本充滿活力的金融中心- 大阪,發現世上最好的快餐、一位相撲力士出身的大廚,以及味道令人死而無憾的蕎麥麵。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw explores Japans high-energy financial centre, Osaka, and finds the worlds best fast food, a sumo wrestler turned chef, and soba noodles to die for.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在日本南部的九州和四國,廖崇明發現了一個充滿活力、溫馨的文化,該地的美食跟人民一樣迷人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Japans southern islands of Kyushu and Shikoku, Adam Liaw finds a vibrant, warm culture where the cuisine is as fascinating as its people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明前往沖繩結束他的日本美食之旅,他在當地發現一道集大成的美食,並瞭解了長壽的秘訣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam ends his taste tour through Japan with a trip to the island of Okinawa, where he discovers an eclectic cuisine and learns the secret to long life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿與朋友莉莉星和蘿拉馬拉諾一起串餐廳,沉浸在植物性飲食中,法式糕點、五香「牛肉」炸角、泰式「雞」翼和燒「牛扒」。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena restaurant-hops with friends Lilly Singh and Laura Marano, indulging in plant-based French pastries, pastrami sammies, Thai chicken wings and carne asada.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走進 Cher 的世界——這位歷久不衰的傳奇人物,從平凡起步到超級巨星,她的旅程在五十多年來深刻影響了流行文化。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Step into the world of Cher, an enduring icon whose journey from humble beginnings to superstardom has shaped pop culture for over five decades

epg.programme_title_tc: 布魯斯威利: 全美英雄
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 布斯韋利士憑著在《虎膽龍威》中飾演尊麥堅這個標誌性角色而成為巨星,他在傳奇的演藝生涯演出過百部電影。他以魅力和幽默而聞名,但卻在2022年遭遇悲慘的挫折。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bruce Willis became a star with his iconic role as John McClane in Die Hard, leading to a legendary career with over 100 films. Known for his charm and humor, his career faced a tragic setback in 2022.

epg.programme_title_tc: 內馬爾: 巴西頭號射手
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從山度士街頭到成為巴西隊頭號射手,內馬爾20年的歷程值得載入史冊。內馬爾幾乎在每個大洲都踢過足球,他將永遠成為球壇的傳說。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the streets of Santos to becoming Brazils number one goal scorer, the 20-year journey of Neymar is one for the history books. Having played football on nearly every continent, Neymar will go down as a legend of the game, forever.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這裡擁有地中海一些最美麗的希臘神廟、似乎漂浮在海上的城市,還有地球上其中一個威力最大的火山,義大利這地區感覺就如平行世界。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With some of the most beautiful Greek temples on the Mediterranean, cities that just seem to float above the sea, and one of the most powerful volcanoes on Earth, this region of Italy feels like another world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沿著非洲南部海岸觀賞古老的海蝕洞、現代的高爾夫球場、神秘的地質構造和危險的掠食者。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See ancient sea caves, modern golf courses, mysterious formations, and treacherous predators along Africas South Coast.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明與漁民們一起出海,抓捕到所謂的「百萬金槍」。他還遇到一位在2011年海嘯中救了他員工的豉油製造商。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam goes to sea with the fishermen who caught the so-called `million-dollar tuna. He also meets a soy sauce maker who saved his staff from the 2011 tsunami.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明繼續他的日本烹飪之旅,準備新鮮的壽司,並前往妻子家鄉沉醉一些家鄉滋味。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw continues his culinary tour of Japan, preparing fresh sushi and taking a trip to his wifes hometown to indulge in a little home cooking.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明繼續他的日本烹飪朝聖之旅,品嚐一些最頂級的味噌、名古屋雞肉和和牛,並認識了一位年屆74歲的採鮑潛水員。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw continues his culinary pilgrimage in Japan, devouring some of the finest miso, Nagoya chicken and Wagyu beef, and meeting a 74-year-old abalone diver.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明在東京廣闊的城市版圖中探索一種飲食文化,它不僅維持了「工薪族」的風格,還保留了其烹飪傳統。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the vast urban sprawl of Tokyo, Adam Liaw explores a food culture that not only sustains the `salaryman workers in style but retains culinary traditions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明查訪了一些東京的瘋狂美食餐廳,品嚐了一些有趣的菜式,包括用雞的生殖器官製成的日式烤雞串。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw checks out the restaurants of food-crazy Tokyo and tastes some interesting dishes including Yakitori made from the reproductive organs of chickens.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明在蓬勃發展傳統文化的京都遇到了一位茗茶大師、一位藝伎和一位將義大利飯變成壽司的米芝蓮大廚。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam meets a tea master, a Maiko, and a Michelin chef who turns risotto into sushi in the thriving traditional culture of Kyoto.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站: 中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美、最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物、200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination China will take the audience to some of Yunnans most beautiful and stunning landscapes and homes to around 6000 species of plants, 200 mammals and 500 species of birds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站: 中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美、最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物、200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination China will take the audience to some of Yunnans most beautiful and stunning landscapes and homes to around 6000 species of plants, 200 mammals and 500 species of birds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《納萊迪: 小象故事》講述一隻救助中心小象孤兒的旅程,被委以她生存重任的男人在奮力拯救她生命的同時,也要為保護整個物種而爭分奪秒。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Naledi follows the journey of a baby elephant orphaned in a rescue camp, as the man tasked with her survival races to protect an entire species while fighting to save her life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 起司大師阿弗林・普里斯汀的起司探險之旅從阿爾卑斯山國瑞士展開,這裡是格魯耶爾與經典孔洞艾門塔起司的故鄉。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cheese Master Afrim Pristine begins his cheese expedition in the Alpine country of Switzerland, home of iconic classics like Gruyere and holey Swiss Emmental.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在法國,吃起司幾乎是一項全民嗜好。阿弗林走訪巴黎到諾曼第,探索全國各地悠久而豐富的起司製作歷史。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Eating cheese is a national pastime in France. Here, Afrim uncovers the rich histories of cheesemaking across the country from Paris to Normandy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿弗林深入加拿大魁北克的濃厚起司傳統,當地家族乳酪坊的技藝世代相傳,延續至今。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Afrim takes in the cheesy traditions of la belle province, Quebec, where family fromageries’ traditions have been passed on through generations.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以當時報導「山姆之子」的方式呈現事件,讓你沉浸在這謀殺案的戲劇中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Immerse yourself in the drama of the Son of Sam murders, presented the way the events were covered at the time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》檢視全球生物圈所面臨的存亡威脅,以及對地球和奧特亞羅瓦(紐西蘭)的未來代表著甚麼。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edge of Existence examines existential threats to the worlds biosphere and what it means for the future of the planet, and Aotearoa.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》探索人類有史以來面臨的最大存亡風險之一的未來- 一個生化威脅。從病毒到人造流行病和合成生化武器,科技正加速人造威脅的風險。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edge of Existence explores a future where bio-threats present one of the greatest existential risks that humanity has ever faced. From viruses to man-made pandemics and synthetic bio-weapons, technology is accelerating the risks of man-made threats.

epg.programme_title_tc: 電腦遊戲: 電玩的故事
epg.programme_title_en: Gameplay: The Story Of The Videogame Revolution
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《電腦遊戲: 電玩的故事》是一部關於電子遊戲歷史的專題紀錄片。歷時近 5 年製作,跨越了從技術起源到街機遊戲誕生的時光。從《乓》到《食鬼》、《超級瑪利歐》到《盜墓者羅拉》、《毀滅戰士》、《俠盜獵車手》等等,我們編纂有史以來發展最快的新媒體的非凡故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gameplay is a feature on the history of videogames. From Pong to Pac Man, Super Mario to Lara Croft, Doom, Grand Theft Auto and beyond, we chronicle the remarkable story of the fastest evolving new media of all time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集探索加密貨幣的基礎,並與當地冒著一切風險的加密貨幣先驅面談。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, we explore the foundations of Cryptocurrency and talk to the local crypto pioneers who risked it all.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 現在我們知道為何加密貨幣是何等大事,而我們在本集將認識紐西蘭最大的加密貨幣成功故事之一背後的家族。我們將破除一些加密神話並介紹如何參與的入門。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Now we know why Crypto is such a big deal, through this episode we’ll meet the family behind one of NZ’s biggest Crypto success stories. We’ll dispel some crypto myths and cover the basics of how to get on board.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 執行長亞倫麥當勞和聯合創始人卜候活史密夫告訴我們他們如何在新西蘭創立價值數百萬美元的非同質化代幣業務,並與國際巨星合作。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: CEO Aaron McDonald and Co-Founder Brooke Howard-Smith tell us how they created a multi-million dollar NFT business here in Aotearoa and are collaborating with international superstars.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是勵志的一集,我們花時間與團隊一起將毛利人帶到元宇宙,並了解一些當地的顛覆者,他們關注打造每個人都有歸屬感的數碼世界。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its an inspirational episode, we spend time with the team taking Māori to the metaverse and check-in on a couple of local disrupters focused on making digital worlds where everyone feels like they can belong.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 如果比特幣挖礦真能拯救世界會發生甚麼事?我們在本集會認識一家當地公司,其使命是藉此幫助解決全球暖化問題。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What if Bitcoin mining could actually save the world? Over this episode, we meet the local company on a mission to use it to help solve global warming.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 讓我們介紹鄧嘉瑪,一位開發數碼資料主權的創造家,並瞭解非同質化代幣如何讓我們擁有自己的人工智能。這是能震撼你的一集。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We profile Kaye-Maree Dunn, an innovator developing digital data sovereignty and we find out how NFTs can allow us to own our own artificial intelligence. Its an episode that will blow your mind.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集探索加密貨幣的基礎,並與當地冒著一切風險的加密貨幣先驅面談。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, we explore the foundations of Cryptocurrency and talk to the local crypto pioneers who risked it all.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著電子遊戲崛起,科技巨頭索尼嘗試與任天堂合作。但在一次驚人的背叛後,索尼創立了後來成為世上最成功的遊戲主機。Playstation從此屹立不倒。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With video-games on the rise, Sony, the tech superpower would attempt a collaboration with Nintendo. After a shocking betrayal, Sony founded what would become the world’s most successful chain of video game consoles. The Playstation was here to stay.

epg.programme_title_tc: 內馬爾: 巴西頭號射手
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從山度士街頭到成為巴西隊頭號射手,內馬爾20年的歷程值得載入史冊。內馬爾幾乎在每個大洲都踢過足球,他將永遠成為球壇的傳說。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the streets of Santos to becoming Brazils number one goal scorer, the 20-year journey of Neymar is one for the history books. Having played football on nearly every continent, Neymar will go down as a legend of the game, forever.

epg.programme_title_tc: 布萊德彼特: 突破好萊塢
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 他可能是最性感的荷里活演員之一,但他的職業和個人目標比他的外表更有味道。布萊德彼特。整個荷里活首屈一指的人物之一。一個默默無聞的天才轉變為超級巨星的故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: He may be one of the sexiest Hollywood actors, but his career and personal goals offer much more than his looks. Brad Pitt. One of the leading names in all of Hollywood. The well-known story of an unknown talent who transformed into a superstar.

epg.programme_title_tc: 湯姆漢克斯: 演無不克
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從出身卑微到成為有抱負的演員,再到扮演世上最具標誌性和最著名的角色。他贏得了「美國好人」、「平民」和藝術游牧民的美譽。而我們都知道他……是 湯姆漢克斯。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From humble beginnings to an aspiring thespian to acting as some of the world’s most iconic and notable characters. He has picked up a reputation as ‘America’s Nice Guy’, ’The Everyman’ and a nomad of the arts. But we all know him… as Tom Hanks.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: See ancient sea caves, modern golf courses, mysterious formations, and treacherous predators along Africas South Coast.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從空中俯瞰南非的山脈、繁囂的都市和野性難馴的動物。這是南非從史前骨頭到現代摩天大廈的旅程。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: View South Africas mountain ranges, bustling cities and untamed wildlife from the air. This is South Africas journey from pre-human skeletons to modern Skyscrapers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩頭最老的犀牛將重返大自然。三頭犀牛的失蹤引起鬨動,而年輕的犀牛則逐漸康復和變得快樂。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The two oldest rhinos are set to be released back into the wild. Three rhinos cause a stir as they go missing, while the younger rhinos make steady progress toward health and happiness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 偷獵危機加劇,偷獵者將注意力轉向孤兒們。四周大的牙美拿失去母親後終於在犀牛孤兒院找到庇護。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The poaching crisis intensifies and poachers turn their attention to orphanages. After losing her mother, four-week-old Jamila finally finds sanctuary at The Rhino Orphanage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫南非美食之旅的第一站是繁華的開普敦。他在當地到訪熱鬧的農貿市場,並在 保卡烹調開普馬來咖哩。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren’s first stop on his food trail of South Africa is the bustling city of Cape Town. Here, he visits a lively farmers market and cooks up a Cape Malay Curry in Bo Kaap.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫沿著南非海岸角繼續他的美食之旅,在抵達大森林私人自然保護區前,先到訪卡耶利沙黑人區,那裡是一些具啟發性的微型農業提案的集中地。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren continues his food trail along South Africa’s Cape Coast, stopping off at the township of Khayelitsha, home to some inspiring micro-farming initiatives, before arriving at Grootbos Private Nature Reserve.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫前往開普酒鄉,品嚐一系列當地的葡萄酒,包括南非標誌性紅酒皮諾塔吉和獨特而複雜的加烈葡萄酒華塔菲亞。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren heads to the Cape Winelands, where he tastes a variety of local wines including Pinotage, a signature South African red, and Ratafia, a unique and complex fortified wine.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫美食之旅的下一站是位於卡拉哈里沙漠中心的提斯瓦魯豪華私人野生動物保護區。然後他遇到名廚馬努斯,烹製一些刺激的南非美食。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren’s next stop on his food trail is Tswalu Nature Reserve, in the heart of the Kalahari Desert. Warren then meets with acclaimed Chef Marnus to cook up some exciting South African delicacies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫前往沿海城市德班 - 住在標誌性的蠔盒酒店。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren heads to the coastal city of Durban - where he’s staying at the iconic Oyster Box hotel.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在德班,華倫先到訪著名的麥士生活品味餐廳,享受任性的祖魯烤肉體驗,再與當地導遊浮高碰面,參觀附近一條祖魯村莊。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Durban, Warren visits the famous restaurant Max’s Lifestyle for an indulgent Shisa Nyama experience, before meeting with local guide Thoko to visit a nearby Zulu village.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫美食之行的下一站是克魯格國家公園,南非其中一個最大的野生動物保護區,他住在著名的沙比沙比旅館。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren’s next stop on his food trail is Kruger National Park, one of South Africa’s largest game reserves, where he’s staying at the renowned Sabi Sabi lodge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在喀拉哈里沙漠的中心發現無數的非洲動物,並學習製作傳統麵包乾來配早晨咖啡。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of the Kalahari Desert, Warren spots a myriad of African animals, and learns to make traditional rusks to go with his morning coffee.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明在蓬勃發展傳統文化的京都遇到了一位茗茶大師、一位藝伎和一位將義大利飯變成壽司的米芝蓮大廚。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam meets a tea master, a Maiko, and a Michelin chef who turns risotto into sushi in the thriving traditional culture of Kyoto.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明探索日本充滿活力的金融中心- 大阪,發現世上最好的快餐、一位相撲力士出身的大廚,以及味道令人死而無憾的蕎麥麵。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw explores Japans high-energy financial centre, Osaka, and finds the worlds best fast food, a sumo wrestler turned chef, and soba noodles to die for.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在日本南部的九州和四國,廖崇明發現了一個充滿活力、溫馨的文化,該地的美食跟人民一樣迷人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Japans southern islands of Kyushu and Shikoku, Adam Liaw finds a vibrant, warm culture where the cuisine is as fascinating as its people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明前往沖繩結束他的日本美食之旅,他在當地發現一道集大成的美食,並瞭解了長壽的秘訣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam ends his taste tour through Japan with a trip to the island of Okinawa, where he discovers an eclectic cuisine and learns the secret to long life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿與朋友莉莉星和蘿拉馬拉諾一起串餐廳,沉浸在植物性飲食中,法式糕點、五香「牛肉」炸角、泰式「雞」翼和燒「牛扒」。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena restaurant-hops with friends Lilly Singh and Laura Marano, indulging in plant-based French pastries, pastrami sammies, Thai chicken wings and carne asada.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫來到歷史名城比勒陀利亞,到訪當地農夫市集,與糕點師郎高斯一起製作扭麻條(南非糯冬甩)。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren stops off at the historic city of Pretoria, where he visits the local farmers markets and cooks Koeksisters - South African sticky donuts - with Pastry Chef Nonkosi.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在繁忙的約翰內斯堡的第一站就是充滿活力的索維托小鎮。導遊仙迪帶他乘坐篤篤車​​遊覽,並烹煮了他自己版本的一道南非素菜- 恰卡拉卡。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren is in the bustling city of Johannesburg, and his first stop is the vibrant township of Soweto. He’s taken on a tuk tuk tour by his guide Sindi, and cooks up his version of Chakalala, a South African vegetable relish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 起司大師阿弗林・普里斯汀的起司探險之旅從阿爾卑斯山國瑞士展開,這裡是格魯耶爾與經典孔洞艾門塔起司的故鄉。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cheese Master Afrim Pristine begins his cheese expedition in the Alpine country of Switzerland, home of iconic classics like Gruyere and holey Swiss Emmental.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在法國,吃起司幾乎是一項全民嗜好。阿弗林走訪巴黎到諾曼第,探索全國各地悠久而豐富的起司製作歷史。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Eating cheese is a national pastime in France. Here, Afrim uncovers the rich histories of cheesemaking across the country from Paris to Normandy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿弗林深入加拿大魁北克的濃厚起司傳統,當地家族乳酪坊的技藝世代相傳,延續至今。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Afrim takes in the cheesy traditions of la belle province, Quebec, where family fromageries’ traditions have been passed on through generations.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明在蓬勃發展傳統文化的京都遇到了一位茗茶大師、一位藝伎和一位將義大利飯變成壽司的米芝蓮大廚。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 來認識這些異常的微型動物,牠們利用嬌小的身軀在世上最致命的環境中克險求生。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the extraordinary miniature animals, who use their small size to survive against all odds in the world’s most deadly environments.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 體型異常龐大的動物就需要異常的適應力。從巨大的鯨魚到森林怪物,這些就是自然巨人的史詩式生存故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Extraordinarily large animals need extraordinary adaptations. From mighty whales to forest monsters, these are the epic survival stories of nature’s giants.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 日入而作可帶來極端的挑戰,同時亦帶來巨大的機會。在這沒有光的世界,危險在每個角落蟄伏。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Living your life at night can present extreme challenges - and massive opportunities. In this world without light, danger lurks around every corner.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野外的一年: 約克郡 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 春天來臨。北約克沼澤國家公園裡的動物必須尋找食物、配偶,並組織家庭。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spring comes to the Dales and North York Moors National Parks, the season when the parks animals must find food, a mate and raise a family.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野外的一年: 約克郡 #2
epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 反常的寒冷夏天令約克郡谷地和北約克沼澤國家公園的幾種動物生活艱難,其中包括一隻受傷的西方狍和她的雙胞胎。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Unseasonably cold summer weather causes difficulties for several animals in the Yorkshire Dales and North York Moors, including an injured roe deer and her twins.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野外的一年: 約克郡 #3
epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夏季持續,秋天暫且未到,出人意料的宜人天氣為西方狍們提供了一條救命稻草,因牠們正為即將到來的冬季做準備。至於其他動物,交配季節已到,在文斯卡海灘充滿了睾酮的氣息。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Autumn is on hold as summer continues, with unexpectedly balmy conditions throwing a life line to the roe deer as they prepare for the winter ahead. For other animals, mating season has arrived, making for a testosterone-fuelled time at Ravenscar Beach.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野外的一年: 約克郡 #4
epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 儘管冬季遲來,但對文斯卡海灘的灰海豹來說,冬天就代表著分娩的時間。新生的幼崽現正快速步入成年,在牠們的母親繼續前行前,只有三周的時間來盡量增加體重。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Despite its delayed arrival, for the Grey Seals at Ravenscar Beach winter means it is time to give birth. The newborn pups are now on the fast track to adulthood, with just three weeks to gain as much weight as possible before their mothers move on.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩頭最老的犀牛將重返大自然。三頭犀牛的失蹤引起鬨動,而年輕的犀牛則逐漸康復和變得快樂。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The two oldest rhinos are set to be released back into the wild. Three rhinos cause a stir as they go missing, while the younger rhinos make steady progress toward health and happiness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 偷獵危機加劇,偷獵者將注意力轉向孤兒們。四周大的牙美拿失去母親後終於在犀牛孤兒院找到庇護。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The poaching crisis intensifies and poachers turn their attention to orphanages. After losing her mother, four-week-old Jamila finally finds sanctuary at The Rhino Orphanage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這個令人驚嘆的系列以前所未有的方式揭開《貓頭鷹的秘密生活》,使用特殊的綁定攝影機在春、夏、冬季跟蹤雅息士郡鄉村荒野角落的貓頭鷹家族。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This stunning series uncovers The Secret Life Of Owls as never seen before, using a special camera rig to follow families of owls in a wild corner of rural Essex, through winter, spring and summer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大象團隊在今集迎來令人震驚的消息,獸醫們擔心他們救助的一隻小企鵝,我們也瞭解到如何真正需要一個社區來為動物園提供食物。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, theres shocking news for the elephant team, the vets are concerned about one of their rescued Little penguins, and we find out how it really does take a community to feed the Zoo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從巨型媒體帝國的女繼承人到被通緝的重犯,見證1974年的派蒂赫茲綁架奇案。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From heiress of a giant media empire to wanted felon, witness the strange saga of the Patty Hearst kidnapping of 1974.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以當時報導「山姆之子」的方式呈現事件,讓你沉浸在這謀殺案的戲劇中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Immerse yourself in the drama of the Son of Sam murders, presented the way the events were covered at the time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從古羅馬的工程奇蹟到托斯卡尼中世紀的血腥戰事,還有卡拉拉巨大的大理石採石場,以前所未有的方式穿越義大利中部- 從空中探索它。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the engineering wonders of ancient Rome to the bloody medieval battles of Tuscany, and the colossal marble quarries of Carrara, journey across Central Italy and discover it like never before - from the air.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從時尚之都米蘭出發,渡過威尼斯大運河,到達脫俗的多羅米提山脈和色彩繽紛的五漁村海岸,以前所未有的方式從空中探索義大利北部。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Journey from the fashion capital to Milan, across the great canals of Venice to the otherworldly peaks of the Dolomites and the colorful coast of Cinque Terre to discover Northern Italy like never before - from the air.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 它們的形狀和大小各適其適,是可怕的火山、偉大的古代文明,還有地球上最清澈水域的家。它們就是迷人的義大利島國。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: They come in all shapes and sizes, are home to terrifying volcanoes, magnificent ancient civilizations, and some of the bluest waters on Earth. These are the fascinating worlds of Italys Islands.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這裡擁有地中海一些最美麗的希臘神廟、似乎漂浮在海上的城市,還有地球上其中一個威力最大的火山,義大利這地區感覺就如平行世界。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With some of the most beautiful Greek temples on the Mediterranean, cities that just seem to float above the sea, and one of the most powerful volcanoes on Earth, this region of Italy feels like another world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沿著非洲南部海岸觀賞古老的海蝕洞、現代的高爾夫球場、神秘的地質構造和危險的掠食者。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See ancient sea caves, modern golf courses, mysterious formations, and treacherous predators along Africas South Coast.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從空中俯瞰南非的山脈、繁囂的都市和野性難馴的動物。這是南非從史前骨頭到現代摩天大廈的旅程。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: View South Africas mountain ranges, bustling cities and untamed wildlife from the air. This is South Africas journey from pre-human skeletons to modern Skyscrapers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沿著非洲南部海岸觀賞古老的海蝕洞、現代的高爾夫球場、神秘的地質構造和危險的掠食者。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See ancient sea caves, modern golf courses, mysterious formations, and treacherous predators along Africas South Coast.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站: 中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美、最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物、200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination China will take the audience to some of Yunnans most beautiful and stunning landscapes and homes to around 6000 species of plants, 200 mammals and 500 species of birds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站: 中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美、最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物、200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination China will take the audience to some of Yunnans most beautiful and stunning landscapes and homes to around 6000 species of plants, 200 mammals and 500 species of birds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《納萊迪: 小象故事》講述一隻救助中心小象孤兒的旅程,被委以她生存重任的男人在奮力拯救她生命的同時,也要為保護整個物種而爭分奪秒。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Naledi follows the journey of a baby elephant orphaned in a rescue camp, as the man tasked with her survival races to protect an entire species while fighting to save her life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩頭最老的犀牛將重返大自然。三頭犀牛的失蹤引起鬨動,而年輕的犀牛則逐漸康復和變得快樂。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The two oldest rhinos are set to be released back into the wild. Three rhinos cause a stir as they go missing, while the younger rhinos make steady progress toward health and happiness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 偷獵危機加劇,偷獵者將注意力轉向孤兒們。四周大的牙美拿失去母親後終於在犀牛孤兒院找到庇護。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The poaching crisis intensifies and poachers turn their attention to orphanages. After losing her mother, four-week-old Jamila finally finds sanctuary at The Rhino Orphanage.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野外的一年: 約克郡 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 春天來臨。北約克沼澤國家公園裡的動物必須尋找食物、配偶,並組織家庭。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spring comes to the Dales and North York Moors National Parks, the season when the parks animals must find food, a mate and raise a family.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野外的一年: 約克郡 #2
epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 反常的寒冷夏天令約克郡谷地和北約克沼澤國家公園的幾種動物生活艱難,其中包括一隻受傷的西方狍和她的雙胞胎。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Unseasonably cold summer weather causes difficulties for several animals in the Yorkshire Dales and North York Moors, including an injured roe deer and her twins.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野外的一年: 約克郡 #3
epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夏季持續,秋天暫且未到,出人意料的宜人天氣為西方狍們提供了一條救命稻草,因牠們正為即將到來的冬季做準備。至於其他動物,交配季節已到,在文斯卡海灘充滿了睾酮的氣息。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Autumn is on hold as summer continues, with unexpectedly balmy conditions throwing a life line to the roe deer as they prepare for the winter ahead. For other animals, mating season has arrived, making for a testosterone-fuelled time at Ravenscar Beach.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野外的一年: 約克郡 #4
epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 儘管冬季遲來,但對文斯卡海灘的灰海豹來說,冬天就代表著分娩的時間。新生的幼崽現正快速步入成年,在牠們的母親繼續前行前,只有三周的時間來盡量增加體重。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Despite its delayed arrival, for the Grey Seals at Ravenscar Beach winter means it is time to give birth. The newborn pups are now on the fast track to adulthood, with just three weeks to gain as much weight as possible before their mothers move on.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩頭最老的犀牛將重返大自然。三頭犀牛的失蹤引起鬨動,而年輕的犀牛則逐漸康復和變得快樂。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The two oldest rhinos are set to be released back into the wild. Three rhinos cause a stir as they go missing, while the younger rhinos make steady progress toward health and happiness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 偷獵危機加劇,偷獵者將注意力轉向孤兒們。四周大的牙美拿失去母親後終於在犀牛孤兒院找到庇護。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The poaching crisis intensifies and poachers turn their attention to orphanages. After losing her mother, four-week-old Jamila finally finds sanctuary at The Rhino Orphanage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這個令人驚嘆的系列以前所未有的方式揭開《貓頭鷹的秘密生活》,使用特殊的綁定攝影機在春、夏、冬季跟蹤雅息士郡鄉村荒野角落的貓頭鷹家族。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This stunning series uncovers The Secret Life Of Owls as never seen before, using a special camera rig to follow families of owls in a wild corner of rural Essex, through winter, spring and summer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是勵志的一集,我們花時間與團隊一起將毛利人帶到元宇宙,並了解一些當地的顛覆者,他們關注打造每個人都有歸屬感的數碼世界。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its an inspirational episode, we spend time with the team taking Māori to the metaverse and check-in on a couple of local disrupters focused on making digital worlds where everyone feels like they can belong.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 如果比特幣挖礦真能拯救世界會發生甚麼事?我們在本集會認識一家當地公司,其使命是藉此幫助解決全球暖化問題。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What if Bitcoin mining could actually save the world? Over this episode, we meet the local company on a mission to use it to help solve global warming.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 讓我們介紹鄧嘉瑪,一位開發數碼資料主權的創造家,並瞭解非同質化代幣如何讓我們擁有自己的人工智能。這是能震撼你的一集。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We profile Kaye-Maree Dunn, an innovator developing digital data sovereignty and we find out how NFTs can allow us to own our own artificial intelligence. Its an episode that will blow your mind.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集探索加密貨幣的基礎,並與當地冒著一切風險的加密貨幣先驅面談。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, we explore the foundations of Cryptocurrency and talk to the local crypto pioneers who risked it all.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著電子遊戲崛起,科技巨頭索尼嘗試與任天堂合作。但在一次驚人的背叛後,索尼創立了後來成為世上最成功的遊戲主機。Playstation從此屹立不倒。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With video-games on the rise, Sony, the tech superpower would attempt a collaboration with Nintendo. After a shocking betrayal, Sony founded what would become the world’s most successful chain of video game consoles. The Playstation was here to stay.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是勵志的一集,我們花時間與團隊一起將毛利人帶到元宇宙,並了解一些當地的顛覆者,他們關注打造每個人都有歸屬感的數碼世界。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its an inspirational episode, we spend time with the team taking Māori to the metaverse and check-in on a couple of local disrupters focused on making digital worlds where everyone feels like they can belong.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: What if Bitcoin mining could actually save the world? Over this episode, we meet the local company on a mission to use it to help solve global warming.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野外的一年: 約克郡 #4
epg.programme_title_en: Yorkshire: A Year In The Wild #4

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南太平洋一個偏遠群島的叢林中,一位生物學家正嘗試做著查理斯達爾文和恩斯特邁爾的未竟之事:  在新物種創造過程中捕捉進化的身影。懷艾伯特在所羅門群島即將有一個驚人的發現,但一個危機慢慢逼近。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the jungles of a remote archipelago in the South Pacific, a biologist is attempting to do something Charles Darwin and Ernst Mayr never accomplished: catch evolution in the act of creating new species. Albert Uy is on the verge of an amazing discovery in the Solomon Islands, but theres a threat looming on the horizon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集認識一些動物長老,牠們幫我們瞭解與長壽相關的心理機制,以及長壽動物為其社區帶來的正面社會價值。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we meet some animal elders who help us understand the psychological mechanisms associated with long life and the positive social value long-lived animals bring to their communities.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明在蓬勃發展傳統文化的京都遇到了一位茗茶大師、一位藝伎和一位將義大利飯變成壽司的米芝蓮大廚。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam meets a tea master, a Maiko, and a Michelin chef who turns risotto into sushi in the thriving traditional culture of Kyoto.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明探索日本充滿活力的金融中心- 大阪,發現世上最好的快餐、一位相撲力士出身的大廚,以及味道令人死而無憾的蕎麥麵。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw explores Japans high-energy financial centre, Osaka, and finds the worlds best fast food, a sumo wrestler turned chef, and soba noodles to die for.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在日本南部的九州和四國,廖崇明發現了一個充滿活力、溫馨的文化,該地的美食跟人民一樣迷人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Japans southern islands of Kyushu and Shikoku, Adam Liaw finds a vibrant, warm culture where the cuisine is as fascinating as its people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明前往沖繩結束他的日本美食之旅,他在當地發現一道集大成的美食,並瞭解了長壽的秘訣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam ends his taste tour through Japan with a trip to the island of Okinawa, where he discovers an eclectic cuisine and learns the secret to long life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿與朋友莉莉星和蘿拉馬拉諾一起串餐廳,沉浸在植物性飲食中,法式糕點、五香「牛肉」炸角、泰式「雞」翼和燒「牛扒」。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena restaurant-hops with friends Lilly Singh and Laura Marano, indulging in plant-based French pastries, pastrami sammies, Thai chicken wings and carne asada.

epg.programme_title_tc: 紅粉佳人: 無所畏懼
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: P!nk 是流行與搖滾樂壇的強大存在。雖然她最初被視為九○年代末眾多青少年流行歌手之一,但她最終開創了屬於自己的音樂風格,並穩固了無可取代的地位。她,是當今樂壇不可忽視的力量。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Pink is a powerhouse of pop and rock music. Although initially seen as yet another act in the late 90’s crowd of teen pop acts, she has since gone on to define her own genre and solidified her place as a standout from the rest. She is a force to be reckoned with in the music scene.

epg.programme_title_tc: 妮可基嫚:  走向奧斯卡
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部專題紀錄片聚焦澳洲傳奇 Nicole Kidman 的早年生活、電影事業,以及她所經歷的高低起伏。從叢林中的聖誕節到奧斯卡得主,她的故事充滿啟發與考驗。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Feature documentary about the early life, filmic career, and trials and tribulations of Australian icon, Nicole Kidman. From a Bush Christmas to Oscar winning performances, her story is one of inspiration and hardship.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走進 Cher 的世界——這位歷久不衰的傳奇人物,從平凡起步到超級巨星,她的旅程在五十多年來深刻影響了流行文化。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Step into the world of Cher, an enduring icon whose journey from humble beginnings to superstardom has shaped pop culture for over five decades

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 來認識這些異常的微型動物,牠們利用嬌小的身軀在世上最致命的環境中克險求生。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the extraordinary miniature animals, who use their small size to survive against all odds in the world’s most deadly environments.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 體型異常龐大的動物就需要異常的適應力。從巨大的鯨魚到森林怪物,這些就是自然巨人的史詩式生存故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Extraordinarily large animals need extraordinary adaptations. From mighty whales to forest monsters, these are the epic survival stories of nature’s giants.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 日入而作可帶來極端的挑戰,同時亦帶來巨大的機會。在這沒有光的世界,危險在每個角落蟄伏。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Living your life at night can present extreme challenges - and massive opportunities. In this world without light, danger lurks around every corner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當冬季來臨,氣溫驟降,食物亦變得稀缺。但有些動物已經進化出獨特的適應力,能夠在世上最冷、最貧瘠的環境中繁衍。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When winter arrives, temperatures plummet and food becomes scarce. But some animals have evolved unique adaptations to flourish in the world’s most cold and barren landscapes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這些動物生活在極端環境中,卻創造出巧妙的工具和技術來為生存應對最嚴峻的挑戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: These animals live in the extremes but have created ingenious tools and techniques to cope with the harshest challenges to their continued survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從出生起就充滿了風險和回報。動物為了成年必須不斷克服難以置信的障礙。牠們必須學習覓食、保護家園、吸引配偶、養兒育女,心心念念一件事──生存下去。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From birth life is filled with risk - and reward. To reach adulthood, animals must constantly overcome incredible obstacles. They must learn to find food, secure a home, attract a mate, and raise the next generation with only one thing on their mind - staying alive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》探索人類有史以來面臨的最大存亡風險之一的未來- 一個生化威脅。從病毒到人造流行病和合成生化武器,科技正加速人造威脅的風險。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edge of Existence explores a future where bio-threats present one of the greatest existential risks that humanity has ever faced. From viruses to man-made pandemics and synthetic bio-weapons, technology is accelerating the risks of man-made threats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》探索一個近未來,人工智能統治著地球和我們。人工智能將伴隨我們一生,並帶來人類史上所面臨的最大存亡風險。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edge of Existence explores a near-future where artificial intelligence rules the planet, and us. AI will arrive in our life-times bringing with it the biggest existential risk humanity has ever faced.

epg.programme_title_tc: 中途島海戰: 真實故事
epg.programme_title_en: Battle Of Midway: The True Story
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入瞭解中途島海戰,大戰時雙方使用的飛機,以及一位戰鬥機機師的戲劇性故事,還有他在美國第一次太平洋戰爭獲得真正勝利中的關鍵作用。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An inside look at the Battle of Midway, the aircraft used on both sides of the fight, and the dramatic story of one fighter pilot and his pivotal role in America’s first true victory of the Pacific War.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從空中俯瞰南非的山脈、繁囂的都市和野性難馴的動物。這是南非從史前骨頭到現代摩天大廈的旅程。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: View South Africas mountain ranges, bustling cities and untamed wildlife from the air. This is South Africas journey from pre-human skeletons to modern Skyscrapers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 翱翔於廣闊的沙漠、巨大的鑽石和​​世上最大的內陸綠洲之上。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Soar over vast deserts, enormous diamonds, and the worlds largest inland oasis.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大象團隊在今集迎來令人震驚的消息,獸醫們擔心他們救助的一隻小企鵝,我們也瞭解到如何真正需要一個社區來為動物園提供食物。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, theres shocking news for the elephant team, the vets are concerned about one of their rescued Little penguins, and we find out how it really does take a community to feed the Zoo.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: When winter arrives, temperatures plummet and food becomes scarce. But some animals have evolved unique adaptations to flourish in the world’s most cold and barren landscapes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每年春天,在挪威海域,鯨魚會運用一種聰明的捕獵技巧——「氣泡網捕食」來捕捉大量鯡魚。當牠們發現魚群時,便開始包圍獵物,並不斷釋放氣泡形成一道空氣幕牆,將魚群困在其中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every spring in Norway, whales use a clever hunting technique called “bubble feeding” to catch quantities of herring. When they spot a shoal of herring, they begin to encircle the herring, periodically releasing streams of bubbles that form a curtain of air, surrounding the fish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集認識一些動物長老,牠們幫我們瞭解與長壽相關的心理機制,以及長壽動物為其社區帶來的正面社會價值。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we meet some animal elders who help us understand the psychological mechanisms associated with long life and the positive social value long-lived animals bring to their communities.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識一些黃昏戀人,探索他們性長壽,以及晚年生育能力仍然旺盛的原因。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet some late-life lovers and explore the reasons behind their sexual longevity and their ability to reproduce well into their later years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著動物老去,如何保持領導地位?我們調查作為一個狼群年老領導者所承擔的責任與挑戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What does it take to maintain alpha status as animals grow older? We investigate the responsibilities and challenges that come with being a senior leader of a pack.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿弗林深入加拿大魁北克的濃厚起司傳統,當地家族乳酪坊的技藝世代相傳,延續至今。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Afrim takes in the cheesy traditions of la belle province, Quebec, where family fromageries’ traditions have been passed on through generations.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿弗林在自己的家鄉多倫多展開一場迷你環球起司之旅,這座城市是世界上最多元且充滿文化魅力的地方之一。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Afrim takes a mini cheese trip around the world in his own backyard, Toronto, one of the most diverse and cultural cities on the planet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿弗林的最後一站是風景如畫的加拿大卑詩省西岸,當地創新的起司文化由「支持在地」的精神所驅動。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Afrim’s final stop is beautiful British Columbia, Canada’s West coast, where an innovative cheese culture is driven by its ‘support local’ mentality.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走進 Cher 的世界——這位歷久不衰的傳奇人物,從平凡起步到超級巨星,她的旅程在五十多年來深刻影響了流行文化。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Step into the world of Cher, an enduring icon whose journey from humble beginnings to superstardom has shaped pop culture for over five decades

epg.programme_title_tc: 布魯斯威利: 全美英雄
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 布斯韋利士憑著在《虎膽龍威》中飾演尊麥堅這個標誌性角色而成為巨星,他在傳奇的演藝生涯演出過百部電影。他以魅力和幽默而聞名,但卻在2022年遭遇悲慘的挫折。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bruce Willis became a star with his iconic role as John McClane in Die Hard, leading to a legendary career with over 100 films. Known for his charm and humor, his career faced a tragic setback in 2022.

epg.programme_title_tc: 內馬爾: 巴西頭號射手
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從山度士街頭到成為巴西隊頭號射手,內馬爾20年的歷程值得載入史冊。內馬爾幾乎在每個大洲都踢過足球,他將永遠成為球壇的傳說。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the streets of Santos to becoming Brazils number one goal scorer, the 20-year journey of Neymar is one for the history books. Having played football on nearly every continent, Neymar will go down as a legend of the game, forever.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站: 中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美、最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物、200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination China will take the audience to some of Yunnans most beautiful and stunning landscapes and homes to around 6000 species of plants, 200 mammals and 500 species of birds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站: 中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美、最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物、200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination China will take the audience to some of Yunnans most beautiful and stunning landscapes and homes to around 6000 species of plants, 200 mammals and 500 species of birds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《納萊迪: 小象故事》講述一隻救助中心小象孤兒的旅程,被委以她生存重任的男人在奮力拯救她生命的同時,也要為保護整個物種而爭分奪秒。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Naledi follows the journey of a baby elephant orphaned in a rescue camp, as the man tasked with her survival races to protect an entire species while fighting to save her life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每年春天,在挪威海域,鯨魚會運用一種聰明的捕獵技巧——「氣泡網捕食」來捕捉大量鯡魚。當牠們發現魚群時,便開始包圍獵物,並不斷釋放氣泡形成一道空氣幕牆,將魚群困在其中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every spring in Norway, whales use a clever hunting technique called “bubble feeding” to catch quantities of herring. When they spot a shoal of herring, they begin to encircle the herring, periodically releasing streams of bubbles that form a curtain of air, surrounding the fish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海洋生物學家伊芙・朱爾丹與理查德・考利奧森,已在挪威研究虎鯨兩年之久,觀察牠們如何將「旋轉圍捕」技巧適應於當地環境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Marine biologists Eve Jourdain and Richard Kaoliussen have spent two years studying the orcas in Norway, where they have adapted the carrousel technique to their habitat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在深海之中,敏捷迅速的海獅展現驚人的水下動作,以智取敵人。在巴塔哥尼亞的海灘上,一隻幼海獅正學習游泳,而掠食者已悄然準備發動致命攻擊。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the depths of the ocean, swift and agile sea lions perform incredible underwater maneuvers to outwit their enemies. Here, on the beaches of Patagonia, as a sea lion pup learns to swim, predators are preparing an attack on him, one that will be fatal.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 好望角塘鵝是強悍的獵手,翱翔海岸尋找最愛的獵物——沙丁魚群,並等待一位意想不到的盟友: 海豚的協助。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cape Gannets are tough hunters flying over the coasts for their favorite prey: shoals of sardines, waiting for a surprising ally: dolphins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在好望角十字角炙熱的陽光下,大批海豹群聚於納米比亞骷髏海岸。雄性海豹體重可達 360 公斤,巡守領域以保護雌性與幼崽。然而,新的陸地掠食者正逼近,迫使牠們學習全新的防禦行為。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Under the burning sun of Cape Cross, large colonies of seals gather on Namibias Skeleton Coast...The males, who can weigh up to 360 kg, patrol the territory to protect their females and young. But new predators are coming from the land, forcing them to learn new defense behaviors.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴塔哥尼亞瓦爾德斯半島的中心,鯨魚經常遭到一種體型嬌小卻意圖兇殘的掠食者襲擊——海鷗。牠們迫使鯨魚潛入深海,遠離賴以生存的氧氣與光線。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of the Valdees Peninsula, in Patagonia, whales are regularly hunted by a predator whose diminutive size hides its gruesome intentions: the seagull, forcing whales to dive deep into the depths, away from essential oxygen and light.

epg.programme_title_tc: 中途島海戰: 真實故事
epg.programme_title_en: Battle Of Midway: The True Story
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入瞭解中途島海戰,大戰時雙方使用的飛機,以及一位戰鬥機機師的戲劇性故事,還有他在美國第一次太平洋戰爭獲得真正勝利中的關鍵作用。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An inside look at the Battle of Midway, the aircraft used on both sides of the fight, and the dramatic story of one fighter pilot and his pivotal role in America’s first true victory of the Pacific War.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沖繩是20世紀最後一場大戰中最後一仗的地點,傷亡數以萬計。軍事攝影師排除萬難冒著生命危險記錄這場衝突,從殘暴的陸戰到神風敢死隊激烈的海襲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Okinawa was the site of the last battle of the last great war of the 20th century, with a casualty rate in the tens of thousands. Through it all, military cameramen risked their lives to film the conflict, from brutal land combat to fierce kamikaze attacks at sea.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獲伯沿著巴拿馬運河旅行,以瞭解無法被征服的地峽如何屈服於堅定的工程師的意志和技巧之下,從而創造出現今的七大奇蹟之一。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rob journeys along the length of the Panama Canal to learn how the un-conquerable Isthmus was bent to the will and skill of determined engineers, creating one of the seven wonders of the Modern World.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 翱翔於廣闊的沙漠、巨大的鑽石和​​世上最大的內陸綠洲之上。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Soar over vast deserts, enormous diamonds, and the worlds largest inland oasis.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從數千尺高空探索西開普省驚人的海岸線、雄偉的山脈和豐富多樣的大都會。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore the Western Capes stunning shorelines, dramatic mountains, and richly-diverse metropolis, from thousands of feet in the air.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小企鵝史拿帕在今集回到領地,但牠會被接納嗎?獸醫團隊準備治療蘇門答臘虎沙利,動物園則幫助拯救瀕危的本地物種。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, Little penguin Snapper returns to the colony but will he be accepted? The vet team prepare to treat Samantran tiger Sali, and the Zoo helps to save an endangered native species at risk.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Sulcata tortoises are the third largest land tortoise in the world, native to the Sahel Corridor in Africa. They do not come from the desert!!! They need to take baths and drink water too!!!
They are 5 to 7 centimeters tall at birth, with bright black eyes that are super attractive. They grow really fast when healthy, adults can reach 0.9 meters in size and live over 100 years. But they will easily catch a cold and get sick if you are not careful. How to keep your turtles healthy? Let’s hear what the experts say!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Sulcata tortoises are the third largest land tortoise in the world, native to the Sahel Corridor in Africa. They do not come from the desert!!! They need to take baths and drink water too!!!
They are 5 to 7 centimeters tall at birth, with bright black eyes that are super attractive. They grow really fast when healthy, adults can reach 0.9 meters in size and live over 100 years. But they will easily catch a cold and get sick if you are not careful. How to keep your turtles healthy? Let’s hear what the experts say!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In Essex Animal Collection officer Joe White's on his way to pick up a dog that's been left abandoned and tethered to the edge of a bridge. Last year the charity received over 63,000 reports of abandoned animals, and nearly half of those were dogs. When Joe arrives in Harlow, the lady who found the dog has moved him to a place of safety and is waiting with a couple of concerned neighbours. With his bones clearly visible through his already skinny frame, the poor dog is worryingly thin. But a lack of food isn't all that's wrong, there are scars on his face and body that suggest he's been through a hard youth. To try and piece together the dog's history Joe needs all the information he can gather.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In the UK nearly a quarter of the adult population have made a dog part of their family. But there are some reports RSPCA inspectors respond to that have them thinking otherwise, and in Staffordshire Inspector Charlotte Melvin is left reeling from the shock of what she finds when she investigates one such case. She receives a complaint about a house full of animals, some in cages and living in cramped and dirty conditions. When she arrived things looked so bad that Charlotte calls the police who help her gain access to the property. Inside there's a menagerie of different creatures, from a fox to a snake, to a lizard, all suffering in totally unsuitable quarters. Two of the worst affected are dogs Mocha and Lexi. Mocha has extreme hair loss. As well as having the same terrible skin problems as Mocha, Lexi is also severely emaciated. Charlotte must act fast to help all the animals to survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Comedian Alan Davies is acting vet's assistant at Harmsworth animal hospital in London. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles. He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets. In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards. The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball. How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets. How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In the wild, survival is a fight. Whether it’s aggression… defense… or avoidance… the strategies of that fight are known as agonism.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In this episode of Animal Super Senses, we find out more about the animals that have their feet firmly planted on or under the ground... and find out how their senses are tuned to survive. What we see above the ground is only a small part of the natural world, …a busy, complex web of life lies just beneath our feet. Fossorial animals are well adapted to life underground.  They live in burrows, tunnels, and mounds using the earth, or whatever substrate they live in, to build their homes, find their food and friends, and stay safe from enemies.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the wild, survival is a fight. Whether it’s aggression… defense… or avoidance… the strategies of that fight are known as agonism.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In this episode of Animal Super Senses, we find out more about the animals that have their feet firmly planted on or under the ground... and find out how their senses are tuned to survive. What we see above the ground is only a small part of the natural world, …a busy, complex web of life lies just beneath our feet. Fossorial animals are well adapted to life underground.  They live in burrows, tunnels, and mounds using the earth, or whatever substrate they live in, to build their homes, find their food and friends, and stay safe from enemies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Animals use communication to attract mates, warn off predators, defend territory, or trick their prey.  And of course, it’s the senses that play the key role - Sight, smell, taste, touch, and hearing - all are employed to send signals to others…in the hope actions speak louder than words.  In this episode of Animal Super Senses, we find out more about the sensory powers used by animals to make messages loud and clear.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In this last episode of animal Super Senses we take the grand final tour to see the greatest of all the  special weapons that help some animals to govern the wilderness. In this episode we literally see it, hear it, touch it, smell it and taste it like animals do. Come and see the champions of the animal supremeness yourselves.

From Africa to Asia, they are targeted for their meat and immense fins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: While all life began in the oceans, human beings now rely on technology to navigate the seven seas – left to our own devices; we’re like the proverbial fish out of water. epg.episode_synopsis_en: A bookworm becomes the librarian. Same night a magical spear gets stolen and hes off to get some real life experience around the globe on his quest for the spear - starting with being thrown off a plane over Amazonas by his cute helper.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Johnny learns Cobra Kai is banned from the All Valley Tournament, he faces the City Council. Miguel asks Samantha out. Robbie takes lessons from Daniel, just as his buddies plot a heist from LaRusso Auto.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: When a deadly secret resurfaces, five friends are stalked by a vengeful killer.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The National Finals conclude in Las Vegas as the remaining ninjas compete in Stage 3 and 4 and a $1 million winner is crowned as the next American Ninja Warrior.

When a known smuggler is flagged at the New York border with unidentified cargo, Colin and Bill head upstate to track. To find this smuggler, they must enlist the help of a foreign intelligence officer looking to defect.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 自當列度(雲迪素飾)一家的傳奇故事在洛杉磯地下賽車界展開後,他們一次又一次征服不可能的挑戰,憑智慧,膽色與車技力壓所有敵人.然而,團隊在巴西對付邪惡黑幫首領時,並不知道首領之子丹堤(積遜莫瑪飾)在暗處觀察.丹堤比以往任何敵人都更為心狠手辣,如今以可怕的全新宿敵姿態崛起,並滿懷復仇之火,誓要粉碎阿當的家庭,摧毀他所愛的一切.由倫敦,巴西到南極與羅馬,團隊獲得新盟友的同時,舊敵又再度現身.可是,阿當發現丹堤的最終目標竟是他年僅八歲的兒子,形勢頓時複雜起來.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A terrifying threat (Jason Momoa) surfaces from the past and is determined to destroy everything and everyone Dom (Vin Diesel) loves in the familys deadliest mission ever.

epg.programme_title_tc: 超級瑪利歐兄弟大電影
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片講述一對布魯克林水管工的故事--瑪利歐與路易吉,他們既是兄弟,也是最好的朋友.勇敢的瑪利歐總是抱著去吧!的精神;而路易吉則常年焦慮,較喜歡哪裡都不去.故事開場,超級瑪利歐兄弟的水管生意欠佳,並意外捲入蘑菇王國的奇幻冒險.在旅程中,我們遇見一群熟悉又可愛的角色,最終還攜手對抗渴望權力的反派庫巴.超級瑪利歐兄弟大電影把全球千萬玩家35年來的所愛提升至全新境界,化為令人屏息的電影體驗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Super Mario Bros. Movie follows Mario and Luigi on a whirlwind adventure through Mushroom Kingdom, uniting with a cast of familiar characters to defeat Bowser.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟Cyril一起踏遍亞洲各地,一邊尋找自我,一邊聽他分享他魔術中的奧妙.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join Cyril on a journey of self-discovery in various locations across Asia as he shares the marvels of his magic.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場停電使全城陷入混亂,20部隊被迫到街上進行緊急巡邏.漢度與小隊發現有恐怖威脅,事態更添嚴峻.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A blackout throws the city into chaos, forcing 20-Squad onto the streets for an emergency patrol day, which quickly escalates when Hondo and team uncover a terror threat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 譚的女友被綁架,使他驚慌失措,20部隊必須爭分奪秒,追查可能是綁架案幕後黑手的暴力販毒集團頭目.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tan is left reeling when his girlfriend is kidnapped, and 20-Squad must race to track down a violent cartel leader who may be behind the abduction.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 彭德頓營附近發生一宗謀殺案,引領吉布斯與團隊來到聖地牙哥郊區一個商場,吉布斯更親自處理事件.積遜吉布斯突然造訪法蘭斯.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A murder near Camp Pendleton leads Gibbs and the team to a suburban mall in San Diego, where Gibbs takes matters into his own hands. Jackson Gibbs pays Franks an unexpected visit.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 吉布斯仍然沉浸在失去妻女的悲痛之中,但仍幫團隊調查一宗涉及失蹤女孩的案件.吉布斯的人生被徹底改寫的一刻,終於揭曉.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Still grieving the loss of his wife and daughter, Gibbs helps the team work a case involving a missing girl. The moment that irrevocably changed Gibbs life is revealed.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A mysterious caller threatens to reveal a leaked list of undercover FBI agents if a prisoner is not released.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ladybug (Brad Pitt), an unlucky assassin determined to do his job peacefully, is on a mission that puts him on a collision course with lethal adversaries.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 五個朋友無意中釀成致命車禍,事後決定隱瞞與事件的關連,並約定保守秘密,而非承擔後果.一年後,這段往事再度纏繞眾人,他們被迫面對可怕的事實-有人知道他們去年夏天的所為……更銳意復仇.五人開始接連被殺手跟蹤,更發現過去也曾發生類似事件,於是便向家傳戶曉的1997年南港大屠殺兩名生還者求助.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When a deadly secret resurfaces, five friends are stalked by a vengeful killer.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: When two students are brutally attacked, 20-Squad contends with a possible honor killing. Meanwhile, Hondo and Nichelle have their first parenting dispute while searching for a suitable daycare.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 陰謀敗露;哈娜,布迪和德蘭尼聯手伸張正義.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The conspiracy is revealed; Hana, Brody and Delaney work together to deliver justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Headquartered in Budapest, the Federal Bureau of Investigations International Fly Team travel the world with the mission of tracking and neutralizing threats against American citizens wherever they may be.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 市長查斯(迪倫沃爾什飾)與紐約市消防局長(美拉蘇文諾飾)緊張關係升溫,法蘭介入.此外,亨利同意在艾琳擔任起訴方的案件中為辯方作證,使艾琳突然措手不及;一個倉儲設施出現人體殘骸,丹尼和拜雅展開調查;愛迪與拍檔巴迪勞順利完成一場複雜的逮捕行動,因為目標罪犯將要捐贈腎臟.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seth heads for Artemis Academy to learn more about Radiant. On the way, he runs into Captain Dragunov of the Inquisition, an organization that cracks down on sorcerers. Even though Seth did nothing wrong, hes arrested just for being a sorcerer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 塞斯抵達阿爾忒彌斯學院後,立即決定參加歡迎新居民的儀式.然而,學院的創始人,至尊大人,卻給他施加了極其嚴厲的懲罰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Immediately after arriving in Artemis Academy, Seth decides to take part in the ceremony welcoming new residents to the city. However, the founder of the academy, Master Lord Majesty, ends up saddling him with a certain immense penalty.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: His assistant in gun related coma, guilt stricken private investigator Jack Taylor leaves Galway for Dublin where he helps a young girl whose mother has been murdered.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一套尚未經測試的全球防禦系統引發毀滅性的太陽閃焰,造成災難性地震與狂暴的磁暴;史無前例的 CAT.8 級末日浩劫.人類能否阻止全面滅絕?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An untested global defense system triggers a swarm of devastating solar flares, resulting in catastrophic earthquakes and ferocious magnetic storms; an unprecedented CAT. 8 Armageddon. Can we stop the annihilation of the human race?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 艾略特威脅奧莉維亞打一通重要的電話.唐被命令去做一些痛苦的事情讓她很掙扎,而維華從姬斯塔得到一些信息.白玫希望艾略特被直接帶到她面前.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Elliot blackmails Olivia to make an important phone call. Dom struggles when shes ordered to do something distressing and Vera gets information out of Krista. Whiterose wants Elliot brought directly to her.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 弗林特和他的船員向全世界宣戰;埃莉諾獲得赦免;範恩對拉克姆的方法提出異議;拿騷最臭名昭著的人物之一回歸.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Flint and his crew wage war against the world; Eleanor is offered clemency; Vane takes issue with Rackhams methods; one of Nassaus most notorious individuals returns.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The true identity of the white-clad group is the inquisitor. Falma is seen as an evil spirit and attacked.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隸屬平民藥師公會的三級藥師皮耶爾在深夜揹著因高燒而痛苦呻吟的女兒,求助無門的他正巧遇見法馬,法馬決定幫忙診治病患。皮耶爾對他親切的回應與高深的學識感到佩服,於是向公會說明事情原委,但卻被不認同異端的公會找碴。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Pierre, a third-class pharmacist, carries his daughter who has high fever and is lost. Luckily, shes treated by Falma.

epg.programme_title_tc: 月光下的異世界之旅 第二季 #17
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 伊爾姆甘德因魔族的陰謀變成了怪物。吉恩和阿貝莉亞等人發起攻擊以阻止他,但他們的攻擊毫無效果......。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ilumgand transforms into a monster due to demon schemes. Jin and Abelia launch an attack to stop him.  However, their attacks have no effect.

epg.programme_title_tc: 月光下的異世界之旅 第二季 #18
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在羅茲卡爾德的混亂中,吉恩和阿貝莉亞等人準備與變異生物戰鬥,而澪在守護一處避難所時遇到了重新甦醒的伊爾姆甘德......。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the chaos of Rotsgard, Jin and his group prepare to fight mutants while Mio, guarding a shelter, encounters the reawakened Ilumgand.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為了營救艾斯,白鬍子海賊團與海軍本部、七武海在馬林福特爆發激戰,而魯夫也率領越獄犯加入戰場。魯夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯卻為了保護他而被赤犬擊殺,白鬍子亦戰死。戰爭最終在紅髮傑克的介入下落幕。經此一戰,魯夫與夥伴們決定分別修行兩年後再會。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rayleigh swims and arrives at the Maiden Island, where he reunites with Luffy. Then he proposes something to Luffy.
